title.en: Volume 310 Biographies 97: Qi Sulei, Ji Ceng Yun, Ji Huang, Gao Bin, Gao Jin, Wan Yan Wei, Gu Cong, Bai Zhongshan
title.raw: 卷310 列傳九十七 齐苏勒 嵇曾筠 嵇璜 高斌 高晋 完颜伟 顾琮 白鍾山

sentences.zh: 列傳九十七

translations.literal: Biographies 97
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 97

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒嵇曾筠子璜高斌從子高晉完顏偉顧琮白鍾山

translations.literal: Qi Sulei; Ji Cengyun; Ji Huang, son of Ji Cengyun; Gao Bin; Gao Jin, nephew of Gao Bin; Wanyan Wei; Gu Cong; Bai Zhongshan
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei; Ji Cengyun; Ji Huang (son of Ji Cengyun); Gao Bin; Gao Jin (Gao Bin's nephew); Wanyan Wei; Gu Cong; Bai Zhongshan

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒，字篤之，納喇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei, style name Duzhi, of the Nara clan, was a man of the Plain White Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei, whose style was Duzhi, belonged to the Nara clan and came from the Manchu Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自官學選天文生為欽天監博士，遷靈臺郎。

translations.literal: Selected from the official school as a student of astronomy, he was appointed doctor of the Directorate of Astronomy, and was transferred to clerk of the Astronomical Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen from the official school as a student of astronomy, he became a doctor at the Directorate of Astronomy and was later promoted to clerk of the Astronomical Terrace.

sentences.zh: 擢內務府主事，授永定河分司。

translations.literal: He was promoted to secretary of the Imperial Household Department and appointed sub-director of the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to secretary in the Imperial Household Department and was given charge of the Yongding River sub-office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十二年，聖祖南巡閱河，齊蘇勒扈蹕。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Kangxi, the Sacred Ancestor made a southern tour to inspect the rivers, and Qi Sulei attended in the imperial retinue.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 42, the Kangxi Emperor toured south to inspect the waterways, and Qi Sulei accompanied the imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 至淮安，上諭黃河險要處應下挑水埽壩，命往煙墩、九里岡、龍窩修築。

translations.literal: When they reached Huai'an, the emperor ordered that at critical points on the Yellow River fascine dams for channeling water should be built, and commanded him to go to Yandun, Jiuligang, and Longwo to carry out the construction.
translations.idiomatic: At Huai'an the emperor directed that fascine works be placed at the Yellow River's most dangerous stretches, and sent Qi Sulei to build them at Yandun, Jiuligang, and Longwo.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒於回鑾前畢工，上嘉之。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei completed the work before the return of the imperial carriage, and the emperor commended him.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei finished the project before the emperor's return journey, and the throne praised his performance.

sentences.zh: 洊擢翰林院侍講、國子監祭酒，仍領永定河分司事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin Academy expositor and chancellor of the Imperial Academy, while still retaining charge of the Yongding River sub-office.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in turn to Hanlin expositor and chancellor of the Imperial Academy, yet continued to oversee the Yongding River sub-office as before.

sentences.zh: 河決武陟，奉命同副都御史牛鈕監修堤工。

translations.literal: When the river breached at Wuzhi, he was ordered, together with Vice Censor-in-Chief Niu Niu, to supervise the repair of the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: After a breach at Wuzhi, he was ordered to supervise dike repairs jointly with Vice Censor-in-Chief Niu Niu.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「自沁河堤頭至滎澤大堤十八里，擇平衍處築遙堤。

translations.literal: In a memorial he said: "From the head of the Qin River dike to the great dike at Xingze, a distance of eighteen li, distant dikes should be built on level ground."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Along the eighteen li from the Qin River dike head to the great Xingze embankment, distant dikes should be raised on the flattest ground available."

sentences.zh: 使河水趨一道，專力刷深，不致旁溢。

translations.literal: This would make the river water pursue a single channel, concentrate force to scour it deeper, and prevent overflow to the sides.
translations.idiomatic: That would confine the current to one course, concentrate its scouring power to deepen the bed, and keep it from spilling sideways.

sentences.zh: 」六十一年，世宗即位，擢山東按察使，兼理運河事。

translations.literal: " In the sixty-first year the Shizong Emperor acceded; Qi Sulei was promoted to provincial surveillance commissioner of Shandong and concurrently placed in charge of Grand Canal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 61 the Yongzheng Emperor took the throne and promoted him to Shandong surveillance commissioner, with concurrent responsibility for the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 命先往河南籌辦黃河堤工。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go first to Henan to plan Yellow River dike works.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent ahead to Henan to organize Yellow River dike projects.

sentences.zh: 時河南巡撫楊宗義請於馬營口南舊有河形處濬引河。

translations.literal: At that time Henan governor Yang Zongyi requested that a diversion channel be dredged south of Mayingkou where an old river course existed.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan governor Yang Zongyi then proposed dredging a diversion channel south of Mayingkou along an old river trace.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒同河道總督陳鵬年疏言：「河不兩行，此洩則彼淤。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei, together with Grand Canal director-general Chen Pengnian, memorialized: "A river cannot run in two courses; if water leaks here, silt will accumulate there."
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei and Canal director-general Chen Pengnian replied in a joint memorial: "The river cannot be split in two—divert flow here and the main channel silts up there."

sentences.zh: 馬營口堤甫成，若開引河，慮旁洩侵堤。

translations.literal: The dike at Mayingkou has only just been completed; if a diversion channel is opened, we fear lateral leakage will undermine the dike.
translations.idiomatic: The Mayingkou dike has only just been finished; opening a diversion now risks side leakage that would eat into the embankment.

sentences.zh: 」事乃寢。

translations.literal: " The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was shelved.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授河道總督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was appointed director-general of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 1 he was appointed director-general of waterways.

sentences.zh: 既上官，疏言：「治河之道，若瀕危而後圖之，則一丈之險頓成百丈，千金之費糜至萬金。

translations.literal: After taking office he memorialized: "In managing rivers, if one waits until danger is imminent before acting, a one-zhang peril instantly becomes a hundred-zhang peril, and an expense of a thousand taels is squandered up to ten thousand."
translations.idiomatic: On assuming office he wrote: "River control fails when you wait until crisis strikes—a one-zhang hazard becomes a hundred-zhang catastrophe, and a thousand-tael repair balloons into ten thousand."

sentences.zh: 惟先時豫防，庶力省而功易就。

translations.literal: Only by preventive measures in advance can effort be saved and success more easily achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Prevention in advance alone saves labor and makes success far easier.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「各堤壩歲久多傾圮，弊在河員廢弛，冒銷帑金。

translations.literal: " He also said: "The various dikes and dams, after many years, have largely collapsed; the evil lies in river officials' neglect and their fraudulent embezzlement of treasury funds."
translations.idiomatic: " He added: "Dikes and dams everywhere have crumbled with age because river officials grew slack and padded expenses from the treasury."

sentences.zh: 宜嚴立定章示懲勸。

translations.literal: Fixed regulations should be strictly established to show punishment and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Strict standing regulations should be set to reward diligence and punish abuse.

sentences.zh: 」並允行。

translations.literal: " All was approved and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved and carried out his proposals.

sentences.zh: 乃週曆黃河、運河，凡堤形高卑闊狹，水勢淺深緩急，皆計裡測量。

translations.literal: He then made a circuit of the Yellow River and Grand Canal, measuring in li every dike's height and breadth and every stretch of water's depth and current.
translations.idiomatic: He then toured the Yellow River and Grand Canal line by line, surveying every embankment's height and width and every reach of current in measured li.

sentences.zh: 總河私費，舊取給屬官，歲一萬三千餘金，及年節餽遺，行部供張，齊蘇勒裁革殆盡。

translations.literal: The director-general's private expenses had formerly been drawn from subordinate officials—more than thirteen thousand taels yearly—together with festival gifts and provisioning for inspection tours; Qi Sulei cut these almost entirely.
translations.idiomatic: The canal chief's personal costs had once been levied on subordinates—over thirteen thousand taels a year, plus holiday gifts and tour provisions—but Qi Sulei abolished nearly all of them.

sentences.zh: 舉劾必當其能否，人皆懍懍奉法。

translations.literal: In recommendations and impeachments he always matched ability to the case, and everyone served the law in awe.
translations.idiomatic: Promotions and dismissals matched real ability, and his staff obeyed the regulations with genuine fear.

sentences.zh: 陽武、祥符、商丘三縣界黃河，北岸有支流三，逼堤繞行五十餘裡；

translations.literal: On the Yellow River at the borders of Yangwu, Xiangfu, and Shangqiu counties, on the north bank there were three branch streams forcing against the dike and winding for more than fifty li;
translations.idiomatic: Along the Yellow River where Yangwu, Xiangfu, and Shangqiu meet, three north-bank branches hugged the dike in a fifty-li loop;

sentences.zh: 南岸青佛寺有支流一，逼堤繞行四十餘裡。

translations.literal: on the south bank at Qingfosi there was one branch stream forcing against the dike and winding for more than forty li.
translations.idiomatic: and on the south bank at Qingfosi a single branch wound against the embankment for more than forty li.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒慮刷損大堤，令築壩堵禦，並接築子堤九千二百八十八丈，隔堤七百八十丈。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei, fearing scour damage to the main dike, ordered dams built to block and defend, and additionally linked subsidiary dikes totaling 9,288 zhang and partition dikes of 780 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the main dike would be scoured away, Qi Sulei had blocking dams raised and added 9,288 zhang of subsidiary embankments plus 780 zhang of partition dikes.

sentences.zh: 又以洪澤湖水弱，慮黃水倒灌，奏築清口兩岸大壩，中留水門，束高清水以抵黃流。

translations.literal: Because Hongze Lake's water was weak and he feared Yellow River water would flow back in, he memorialized to build great dams on both banks at Qingkou, leaving a sluice gate in the center to confine the clear water and resist the yellow current.
translations.idiomatic: Hongze's level was low and he feared Yellow River backflow, so he proposed great dams on both sides of Qingkou with a central sluice to pin the clear lake water against the muddy river.

sentences.zh: 及淮水暢下，壩在波濤中，又慮壩為水蝕，遣員弁駐工，湖漲下埽防壩，黃漲則用混江龍、鐵篦子諸器，駕小舟往來疏濬，不使沙停，水患始緩。

translations.literal: When the Huai flowed freely downward, the dams stood amid surging waves; fearing further erosion, he sent officers to remain on the works—when the lake rose they laid fascines to protect the dams, and when the Yellow rose they used dredging tools such as the Hunjianglong and iron rakes, plying small boats back and forth to clear silt so sand would not settle, and the water peril gradually eased.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Huai ran freely the dams stood in heavy surf; he stationed officers on site—laying fascines when the lake rose, and when the Yellow swelled deploying dredgers and iron rakes from small boats to keep sand from settling—until the crisis eased.

sentences.zh: 詔豫籌山東諸湖蓄洩以利漕運，疏言：「兗州、濟寧境內，如南旺、馬蹋、蜀山、安山、馬場、昭陽、獨山、微山、稀山等湖，皆運道資以蓄洩，昔人謂之'水櫃'。

translations.literal: He was ordered to plan in advance the storage and release of Shandong's lakes to benefit grain transport; in a memorial he said: "Within Yanzhou and Jining, lakes such as Nanwang, Mata, Shushan, Anshan, Machang, Zhaoyang, Dushan, Weishan, and Xishan all serve the transport route for storage and release; the ancients called them 'water cabinets.'"
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to plan how Shandong's lakes could store and release water for the grain route, he wrote: "Lakes from Nanwang to Weishan across Yanzhou and Jining are the canal's reservoirs—what older engineers called 'water cabinets.'"

sentences.zh: 民乘涸佔種，湖身漸狹。

translations.literal: The people, taking advantage of low water to plant fields, have gradually narrowed the lake beds.
translations.idiomatic: Farmers have planted on exposed lakebed whenever water fell, steadily shrinking the lakes.

sentences.zh: 宜乘水落，除已墾熟田，丈量立界，禁侵越。

translations.literal: When water is low, boundaries should be surveyed and fixed, except for already cultivated mature fields, and encroachment forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: At low water we should survey boundaries—except for long-cultivated plots—and forbid further encroachment.

sentences.zh: 謹渟蓄：當運河盛漲，引水使與湖平，即築堰截堵；

translations.literal: For careful storage: when the Grand Canal is in full flood, draw water until it is level with the lakes, then build weirs to block and hold it;
translations.idiomatic: For storage: when the canal is high, channel water until it levels with the lakes, then seal it with weirs;

sentences.zh: 如遇水淺，則引之從高下注諸湖。

translations.literal: if water is shallow, lead it from higher to lower ground into the various lakes.
translations.idiomatic: when water is low, lead it downhill into the lakes.

sentences.zh: 或宜堤，或宜樹，或宜建閘啟閉，令諸州縣量事程功，則湖水深廣，漕艘無阻矣。

translations.literal: Where dikes are suitable, build dikes; where trees are suitable, plant trees; where sluice gates are suitable, build gates to open and close—let each prefecture and county measure the task and schedule the work, and the lakes will be deep and broad, and grain barges unimpeded.
translations.idiomatic: Some sites need dikes, others trees, others sluice gates—let each county plan accordingly, and the lakes will hold enough water for grain transport without obstruction.

sentences.zh: 二年，廣西巡撫李紱入對，上諭及淮、揚運河淤墊年久，水高於城，危險可慮。

translations.literal: In the second year Guangxi governor Li Fu came to audience; the emperor spoke of how the Huai-Yang section of the Grand Canal had silted up over many years, with water higher than the city walls—a peril to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2, when Guangxi governor Li Fu was received in audience, the emperor noted that the Huai-Yang canal had silted for years until the water stood above the city walls—a grave danger.

sentences.zh: 紱請於運河西別濬新河，以其土築西堤；

translations.literal: Li Fu requested that a new channel be dredged west of the canal and its earth used to build a western dike;
translations.idiomatic: Li Fu proposed dredging a new channel west of the canal and using the spoil to build a western embankment;

sentences.zh: 而以舊河身作東堤，東岸當不至潰決。

translations.literal: and the old river bed be made the eastern dike, so the eastern bank should not breach.
translations.idiomatic: with the old channel serving as the eastern dike so the east bank would not fail.

sentences.zh: 上命與齊蘇勒商度，齊蘇勒奏言：「淮河上接洪澤，下通江口。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered consultation with Qi Sulei; Qi Sulei memorialized: "The Huai River above connects with Hongze Lake and below reaches the river mouth."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him to consult Qi Sulei, who replied: "The Huai joins Hongze above and the Yangtze mouth below."

sentences.zh: 西岸臨白馬、寶應、界首諸湖，水勢汪洋無際。

translations.literal: The western bank faces the lakes of Baima, Baoying, Jieshou, and others, where the water stretches boundlessly.
translations.idiomatic: Its west bank faces Baima, Baoying, Jieshou, and other lakes whose waters spread without limit.

sentences.zh: 若別挑新河，築西堤於湖水中，不惟糜費巨金，抑且大工難就。

translations.literal: If a new channel is separately dredged and a western dike built in lake water, not only will vast sums be wasted, but the great work will be hard to complete.
translations.idiomatic: Dredging a new channel and building a western dike out in open lake would waste enormous funds and still be nearly impossible to finish.

sentences.zh: 」上是其言。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor accepted his view.

sentences.zh: 是秋颶風作，海潮騰踴丈餘。

translations.literal: That autumn a hurricane arose, and the sea tide surged more than a zhang high.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn a typhoon struck and the sea tide leaped more than ten feet.

sentences.zh: 黃河入海之路，二水沖激，曆三晝夜，而濱海堤岸屹然。

translations.literal: On the Yellow River's path to the sea the two waters clashed for three days and nights, yet the coastal dikes stood firm.
translations.idiomatic: Where the Yellow River meets the sea the two waters hammered each other for three days and nights, yet the coastal dikes held firm.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其修築堅固，賜孔雀翎，並予拜他喇布勒哈番世職。

translations.literal: The emperor praised the solidity of his construction, bestowed a peacock feather, and granted an hereditary rank of Baitalabuleha fan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his solid work, gave him a peacock feather, and granted an hereditary Baitalabuleha fan rank.

sentences.zh: 三年，副總河嵇曾筠奏於祥符縣回回寨濬引河，事將竣，齊蘇勒奉命偕總督田文鏡察視。

translations.literal: In the third year Vice Director-General Ji Cengyun memorialized on dredging a diversion channel at Huihuizhai in Xiangfu County; as the work was nearing completion, Qi Sulei was ordered to inspect jointly with Governor Tian Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, vice canal chief Ji Cengyun reported dredging a diversion at Huihuizhai in Xiangfu; near completion, Qi Sulei was sent with Governor Tian Wenjing to inspect.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒奏言：「濬引河必上口正對頂沖，而下口有建瓴之勢，乃能吸大溜入新河，藉其水力滌刷寬深。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei memorialized: "In dredging a diversion channel the upper mouth must face directly into the main current, and the lower mouth must have the momentum of water poured from a high eave, so that the main flow can be drawn into the new channel and its force used to scour it wide and deep."
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei argued: "A diversion's upper mouth must meet the main current head-on and its lower mouth must drop like a pouring eave—only then will the main stream be sucked in and scour the new channel wide and deep."

sentences.zh: 今所濬引河，與現在水向不甚相對。

translations.literal: The diversion now dredged does not align well with the present direction of the water.
translations.idiomatic: The channel now dug does not line up well with the current's direction.

sentences.zh: 當移上三十餘丈，對沖迎溜。

translations.literal: It should be shifted upstream more than thirty zhang to meet the current head-on.
translations.idiomatic: It should be moved upstream more than thirty zhang to meet the flow directly.

sentences.zh: 复於對岸建挑水壩，挑溜順行，以對引河之口。

translations.literal: Further, on the opposite bank a deflection dam should be built to turn the current smoothly to align with the diversion mouth.
translations.idiomatic: A deflection dam should also be built on the far bank to steer the current squarely toward the diversion mouth.

sentences.zh: 俟水漲時相機開放，庶河流東注，而南岸堤根可保無虞。

translations.literal: When the water rises it may be opened as circumstances allow, so that the river may flow eastward and the roots of the south-bank dike may be kept secure.
translations.idiomatic: When the river rises it can be opened at the right moment so the current runs east and the south-bank dike foot stays safe.

sentences.zh: 」上命內閣學士何國宗等以儀器測量，命齊蘇勒會勘。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered Grand Secretariat academician He Guozong and others to measure with instruments, and commanded Qi Sulei to join in the survey.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered Academician He Guozong and others to take instrument readings and told Qi Sulei to join the survey.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒奏：「儀器測度地勢，於河工高下之宜甚有準則。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei memorialized: "Instrument measurement of terrain provides very reliable standards for what is suitable in height and level for river works."
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei wrote: "Survey instruments give reliable standards for the proper levels in river works."

sentences.zh: 今洪澤湖滾水壩舊立門檻太高，不便於洩水。

translations.literal: Now the sill of the old overflow dam on Hongze Lake is set too high and is inconvenient for discharging water.
translations.idiomatic: The old overflow dam on Hongze Lake has a sill set too high to release water effectively.

sentences.zh: 請敕諸臣繞至湖口，用儀器測定，將門檻改低，庶宣防有賴。

translations.literal: I request that the ministers be ordered to go around to the lake mouth, measure with instruments, and lower the sill, so that flood control may have a reliable basis.
translations.idiomatic: Please send the officials to the lake mouth to remeasure and lower the sill so flood control can be dependable.

sentences.zh: 」又奏言：「治河物料用葦、柳，而柳尤適宜。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "Materials for river control use reeds and willows, and willows are especially suitable."
translations.idiomatic: " He also proposed: "River works rely on reeds and willows, willows especially."

sentences.zh: 今飭屬於空閒地種柳，沮洳地種葦。

translations.literal: He now ordered subordinates to plant willows on vacant land and reeds on marshy ground.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered subordinates to plant willows on open ground and reeds in marsh.

sentences.zh: 應請凡種柳八千株、葦二頃者，予紀錄一次，著為例。

translations.literal: It should be requested that whoever plants eight thousand willows or two qing of reeds receive one merit record, and this be established as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that planting eight thousand willows or two qing of reeds earn one merit record, fixed as precedent.

sentences.zh: 」均稱旨。

translations.literal: " All were approved as in accord with the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: " All won imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 尋又奏言：「供應節禮，並已裁革。

translations.literal: Soon after he again memorialized: "Provisions for festival gifts have already been cut.
translations.idiomatic: He soon added: "Festival gifts and entertainments have already been abolished.

sentences.zh: 河標四營舊有坐糧，歲千餘金，以之修造墩台，制換衣甲、器械；

translations.literal: The four river-banner camps formerly had sitting-grain allowances of more than a thousand taels yearly, used to repair beacon towers and make or replace armor and weapons;
translations.idiomatic: The four river-banner camps once had standing grain allowances of over a thousand taels a year for beacon towers, armor, and weapons;

sentences.zh: 鹽商陋規歲二千金，為出操驗兵賞功犒勞之用。

translations.literal: the salt merchants' improper custom of two thousand taels yearly was for drilling troops, inspecting soldiers, rewarding merit, and bestowing consolation.
translations.idiomatic: and a salt-merchant custom of two thousand taels yearly paid for drills, inspections, rewards, and troop comforts.

sentences.zh: 每年往來勘估，伏秋兩汛，出駐工次，車馬舟楫，日用所需，拮据實甚。

translations.literal: Each year in going back and forth on surveys, during the summer and autumn flood seasons, staying at work sites, with horses, carts, boats, and daily needs, the strain is truly severe.
translations.idiomatic: Annual inspections and summer and autumn flood duty on site—with horses, boats, and daily expenses—are genuinely costly.

sentences.zh: 河庫道收額解錢糧，向有隨平餘銀五千餘，除道署日用工食，請恩准支銷。

translations.literal: The river treasury circuit, in receiving allotted delivered funds, had more than five thousand taels in scale surplus silver; apart from daily labor and food at the circuit office, he requested imperial grace to authorize its disbursement.
translations.idiomatic: The river treasury circuit's scale surplus—over five thousand taels beyond daily office costs—he asked leave to spend.

sentences.zh: 」上允之。

translations.literal: " The emperor granted it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，以堵築睢寧硃家口決口，加兵部尚書、太子太傅。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, for blocking and building up the breach at Zhujiakou in Suining, he was given the additional titles of Minister of War and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, for closing the breach at Zhujiakou in Suining, he was made Minister of War and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五年，疏言：「黃河鬥岸常患衝激，應改斜坡，俾水隨坡溜，坡上懸密柳抵之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he memorialized: "On the Yellow River, steep banks often suffer from pounding; they should be changed to slopes so water runs off along the slope, with dense willows hung on the slope to resist it."
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he proposed: "Steep Yellow River banks are constantly hammered; make them slopes so water runs off, with dense willows on the face to break the force."

sentences.zh: 既久溜入中泓，柳枝霑泥，並成沙灘，則易險為平。

translations.literal: After long flowing into the central channel, the willow branches are coated with mud and together form sandbanks, and danger is thus changed to level ground.
translations.idiomatic: In time the current enters the main channel, willows silt up into sandbars, and what was perilous becomes level ground.

sentences.zh: 」從其請。

translations.literal: " His request was followed.
translations.idiomatic: " The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 是年，齊蘇勒有疾，上遣醫往視。

translations.literal: That year Qi Sulei fell ill, and the emperor sent a physician to attend him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qi Sulei fell ill and the emperor sent a doctor to see him.

sentences.zh: 尋入覲，命歲支養廉萬金。

translations.literal: Soon after he came to audience and was ordered an annual allowance of ten thousand taels for integrity nourishment.
translations.idiomatic: He soon came to court and was granted ten thousand taels yearly as an integrity allowance.

sentences.zh: 六年，兩江總督範時繹、江蘇巡撫陳時夏濬吳淞江，上命齊蘇勒料理。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Liangjiang governor-general Fan Shiyi and Jiangsu governor Chen Shixia dredged the Wusong River; the emperor ordered Qi Sulei to manage the affair.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, Liangjiang governor Fan Shiyi and Jiangsu governor Chen Shixia dredged the Wusong River, and the emperor put Qi Sulei in charge.

sentences.zh: 築壩陳家渡，松江知府周中鋐、千總陸章乘舟督工下埽，潮回壩陷，溺焉。

translations.literal: While building a dam at Chenjiadu, Songjiang prefect Zhou Zhongqian and company commander Lu Zhang, in boats supervising the laying of fascines, were drowned when the tide returned and the dam collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: At Chenjiadu a dam was under construction when Songjiang prefect Zhou Zhongqian and commander Lu Zhang, supervising fascine work from boats, were drowned as the returning tide collapsed the dam.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒往視察，下為土埂，中有停沙，因督令疏濬，壩工乃竟。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei went to inspect; below was an earthen ridge with settled sand within, and he therefore supervised dredging until the dam work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei inspected the site, found an earthen ridge with trapped sand below, ordered dredging, and the dam was finally finished.

sentences.zh: 复偕曾筠會勘河南雷家寺支河，是秋事畢。

translations.literal: He again joined Ji Cengyun in surveying the branch river at Leijia Temple in Henan, and that autumn the work was finished.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Ji Cengyun to survey the Leijia Temple branch channel in Henan, finishing that autumn.

sentences.zh: 於是黃河自碭山至海口，運河自邳州至江口，縱橫綿亙三千餘裡，兩岸堤防崇廣若一，河工益完整。

translations.literal: Thus from Dangshan to the sea mouth on the Yellow River, and from Pizhou to the river mouth on the Grand Canal, stretching more than three thousand li in all directions, the dikes on both banks were lofty and broad as one, and river works grew more complete.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Yellow River from Dangshan to the sea and the Grand Canal from Pizhou to the Yangtze mouth—more than three thousand li in all—had uniform, towering embankments on both banks, and the whole system was sounder than ever.

sentences.zh: 七年春，疾甚，上復遣醫往視。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year his illness grew severe, and the emperor again sent a physician.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 7 his illness worsened and the emperor again sent a physician.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，賜銀三千兩為歸櫬資，進世職三等阿達哈哈番，賜祭葬，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: Soon after he died; three thousand taels of silver were granted for coffin transport, his hereditary rank was advanced to third-class Adahahan, sacrificial rites and burial honors were bestowed, and his posthumous title was Qinke (Diligent and Respectful).
translations.idiomatic: He soon died. The court gave three thousand taels for his funeral transport, advanced his hereditary rank to third-class Adahahan, granted state rites and burial honors, and posthumously titled him Qinke (Diligent and Respectful).

sentences.zh: 上又以靳輔、齊蘇勒實能為國宣勞，有功民社，命尹繼善等擇地，令有司春秋致祭。

translations.literal: The emperor also held that Jin Fu and Qi Sulei had truly labored for the state and benefited the people's altars of soil and grain, and ordered Yin Jishan and others to choose a site and command the local officials to offer sacrifices in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also judged that Jin Fu and Qi Sulei had truly served the state and the people, and ordered Yin Jishan and others to choose a site for spring and autumn sacrifices by local officials.

sentences.zh: 齊蘇勒久任河督，世宗深器之，嘗諭曰：「爾清勤不待言，而獨立不倚，從未聞夤緣結交，尤屬可嘉。

translations.literal: Qi Sulei long served as river commissioner and the Shizong Emperor greatly valued him; he once instructed him: "Your integrity and diligence need not be spoken of, but your independence and refusal to lean on others—I have never heard of your currying favor or forming cliques—which is especially praiseworthy."
translations.idiomatic: Qi Sulei had long been river commissioner and Yongzheng held him in high regard, once telling him: "Your integrity and diligence go without saying; what I especially admire is that you stand alone and have never been known to court favor or form factions."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「隆科多、年羹堯作威福，攬權勢。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Longkodo and Nian Gengyao wielded power arrogantly and monopolized authority."
translations.idiomatic: " He also said: "Longkodo and Nian Gengyao threw their weight about and hoarded power."

sentences.zh: 隆科多於朕前謂爾操守難信，年羹堯前歲數詆爾不學無術，朕以此知爾獨立也。

translations.literal: Longkodo told me before that your conduct was hard to trust, and Nian Gengyao in recent years repeatedly slandered you as unlearned and without skill; from this I know your independence."
translations.idiomatic: Longkodo told me your integrity was doubtful, and Nian Gengyao kept calling you ignorant and incompetent—that is how I know you stand apart."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「齊蘇勒歷練老成，清慎勤三字均屬無媿。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Qi Sulei is experienced and mature; in the three words 'clear, cautious, and diligent' he has nothing to be ashamed of."
translations.idiomatic: " He also said: "Qi Sulei is seasoned and steady; he has nothing to be ashamed of in the words clear, cautious, and diligent."

sentences.zh: 」八年，京師賢良祠成，復命與靳輔同入祀。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year, when the Worthy Officials Shrine in the capital was completed, he was again ordered to be enshrined together with Jin Fu.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 8, when the Worthy Officials Shrine in the capital was completed, he was again ordered enshrined alongside Jin Fu.

sentences.zh: 嵇曾筠，字松友，江南長洲人。

translations.literal: Ji Cengyun, style name Songyou, was a native of Changzhou in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Cengyun, styled Songyou, came from Changzhou in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 父永仁，諸生，從福建總督范承謨死事；

translations.literal: His father Yongren was a licentiate who died in service following Fujian governor-general Fan Chengmo;
translations.idiomatic: His father Yongren, a licentiate, died in Fan Chengmo's service when the Fujian governor-general was killed;

sentences.zh: 母楊守節，撫曾筠成立：事分見忠義、列女傳中。

translations.literal: his mother Yang preserved her chastity and raised Cengyun to maturity—their stories are told separately in the biographies of the loyal and of exemplary women.
translations.idiomatic: his mother Yang kept her widowhood and raised Cengyun to manhood—their stories appear in the Loyalty and Exemplary Women sections.

sentences.zh: 曾筠，康熙四十五年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: Cengyun passed the jinshi examination in the forty-fifth year of Kangxi, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Cengyun took his jinshi in Kangxi year 45, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and became a compiler.

sentences.zh: 累遷侍講。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to expositor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in turn to Hanlin expositor.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，直南書房，兼上書房。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he served in the Southern Study and concurrently in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 1 he served in the Southern Study and also in the Heir Apparent's study.

sentences.zh: 擢左僉都御史，署河南巡撫，即充鄉試考官。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, acted as Henan governor, and at once served as provincial examination examiner.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, acted as Henan governor, and immediately served as provincial examination examiner.

sentences.zh: 遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was then moved to the post of Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 河決中牟劉家莊、十里店諸地。

translations.literal: The river breached at Liujiazhuang in Zhongmou, Shilidian, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: The river breached at Liujiazhuang in Zhongmou, Shilidian, and other sites.

sentences.zh: 詔往督築，逾數月，工竟。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go and supervise the building; after several months the work was completed.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to supervise repairs, and within months the work was done.

sentences.zh: 二年春，奏言：「黃、沁並漲，漫溢銚期營、秦家廠、馬營口諸堤。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year he memorialized: "The Yellow and Qin rivers both rose together, overflowing the dikes at Yaoqiying, Qinjiachang, Mayingkou, and other places."
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 2 he reported: "The Yellow and Qin rivers rose together and overflowed the dikes at Yaoqiying, Qinjiachang, Mayingkou, and elsewhere."

sentences.zh: 循流審視，窮致患之由。

translations.literal: Following the current he examined it closely and traced the cause of the calamity to its root.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the current upstream and traced the disaster to its source.

sentences.zh: 見北岸長沙灘，逼水南趨，至倉頭口，繞廣武山根，逶迤屈曲而下。

translations.literal: He saw that on the northern bank the Changsha shoal forced the water southward; reaching Cangtou Mouth, it wound around the foot of Guangwu Mountain, meandering and bending as it descended.
translations.idiomatic: On the northern bank he found the Changsha shoal driving the current south; at Cangtou Mouth the river curved around the base of Guangwu Mountain in a long, winding descent.

sentences.zh: 官莊峪又有山嘴外伸，河流由西南直注東北，秦家廠諸地頂沖受險。

translations.literal: At Guanzhuangyu there was also a mountain spur projecting outward; the river flowed straight from southwest toward northeast, and Qinjiachang and other places bore the brunt head-on and faced danger.
translations.idiomatic: At Guanzhuangyu another spur jutted into the channel, so the current ran straight from southwest to northeast and struck Qinjiachang and neighboring areas head-on.

sentences.zh: 請於倉頭口對面橫灘開引河，俾水勢由西北而東南，毋令激射東北；

translations.literal: He requested that a diversion channel be opened through the transverse shoal opposite Cangtou Mouth, so that the water's force would run from northwest to southeast and not be driven in a rushing shot toward the northeast;
translations.idiomatic: He proposed cutting a diversion through the shoal opposite Cangtou Mouth to turn the flow from northwest to southeast and keep it from slamming northeastward.

sentences.zh: 並培釘船幫大壩，更於上下增築減水壩，秦家廠諸地險勢可減。

translations.literal: He also asked to reinforce the nailed-ship-bank major dam, and further to add flood-relief dams above and below, so that the dangerous situation at Qinjiachang and other places could be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He also called for reinforcing the major nailed-ship revetment dam and building additional flood-relief dams upstream and downstream, which would ease the peril at Qinjiachang and nearby.

sentences.zh: 」又與河督齊蘇勒會奏培兩岸堤，北起滎澤，至山東曹縣；

translations.literal: " He also jointly memorialized with River Governor Qisuole to strengthen the dikes on both banks, from Xingze in the north to Caoxian in Shandong;
translations.idiomatic: " He also joined River Governor Qisuole in memorializing to strengthen both banks of the dikes, from Xingze northward to Caoxian in Shandong;

sentences.zh: 南亦起滎澤，至江南碭山：都計十二萬三千餘丈。

translations.literal: On the south it likewise ran from Xingze to Dangshan in Jiangnan: in all more than one hundred twenty-three thousand zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On the south bank the stretch also ran from Xingze to Dangshan in Jiangnan, totaling more than 123,000 zhang.

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 授河南副總河，駐武陟。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Director-General of Henan Rivers and stationed at Wuzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Vice Director-General of Henan river works and posted at Wuzhi.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「鄭州大堤石家橋迤東大溜南趨，應下埽簽椿，复於埽灣建磯嘴壩一。

translations.literal: In a memorial he stated: "On the major dike at Zhengzhou, east of Shijia Bridge the main current trends southward; revetments and piles should be put down, and furthermore one spur dam should be built at the revetment bend."
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "East of Shijia Bridge on the Zhengzhou main dike the chief current was pushing south; he recommended sinking revetments and piles and building one spur dam at the bend."

sentences.zh: 中牟拉牌寨黃流逼射，應下埽護岸，建磯嘴挑水壩二。

translations.literal: At Lapai Zhai in Zhongmou the Yellow current pressed and shot against the bank; revetments should be placed to protect the shore, and two spur water-deflecting dams should be built.
translations.idiomatic: At Lapai Zhai in Zhongmou the Yellow River current was battering the bank; he called for shore-protecting revetments and two spur dams to deflect the water.

sentences.zh: 穆家樓堤工坐衝，亦應下埽加鑲。

translations.literal: The dike works at Mujialou sat in the direct path of impact; revetments should likewise be deployed with added reinforcement.
translations.idiomatic: The Mujialou dike section took the full force of the current and likewise needed revetments with extra reinforcement.

sentences.zh: 陽武北岸祥符珠水、牛趙二處堤工，近因中牟迤下，新長淤灘，大溜北趨成衝，應順埽加鑲。

translations.literal: On the northern bank at Yangwu, at the Zhu River and Niuzhao dike works in Xiangfu, because downstream from Zhongmou a new silt shoal had lately grown, the main current trended north and became a direct assault; revetments should be laid along the flow with added reinforcement.
translations.idiomatic: On Yangwu's north bank, at Zhu River and Niuzhao in Xiangfu, a newly formed silt bar below Zhongmou had lately turned the main current north into a direct hit; he proposed aligned revetments with extra cladding.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「小丹河自辛句口至河內清化鎮水口二千餘裡。

translations.literal: " He also stated: "The Xiao Dan River runs more than two thousand li from Xingoukou to the water mouth at Qinghua Town in Henei."
translations.idiomatic: " He added: "The Xiao Dan River stretches over two thousand li from Xingoukou to the Qinghua Town outlet in Henei."

sentences.zh: 昔人建閘開渠，定三日放水濟漕，一日塞口灌田。

translations.literal: Former men built sluices and opened channels, fixing three days for releasing water to aid grain transport and one day for closing the mouth to irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier administrators had built sluices and canals, allotting three days to release water for the grain boats and one day to close the gate and irrigate the fields.

sentences.zh: 日久閘夫賣水阻運，請嚴飭。

translations.literal: As time passed the sluice attendants sold water and obstructed transport; he requested strict correction.
translations.idiomatic: Over time the gatekeepers had sold water and blocked the canal traffic; he asked that they be strictly disciplined.

sentences.zh: 仍用官三民一之法，違治其罪。

translations.literal: The rule of three days for official use and one for the people should still be applied, and offenders punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed restoring the three-official-days, one-civilian-day rule and punishing violations.

sentences.zh: 」又言祥符南岸回回寨對面淤灘直出河心，致河勢南趨逼省城。

translations.literal: " He also stated that on the southern bank of Xiangfu, opposite Huihuizhai, a silt shoal projected straight into the river's center, causing the river's course to trend south and press upon the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: " He also reported that on Xiangfu's south bank, a silt bar opposite Huihuizhai jutted straight into mid-channel, forcing the river south toward the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 請於北岸舊河身濬引河，導水直行。

translations.literal: He requested dredging a diversion channel in the old riverbed on the northern bank to guide the water in a straight course.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed dredging a diversion in the old channel on the north bank to straighten the flow.

sentences.zh: 上諮齊蘇勒用曾筠議。

translations.literal: The emperor consulted Qisuole and adopted Zeng Jun's proposals.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consulted Qisuole and accepted Zeng Jun's plan.

sentences.zh: 四年，奏衛河水盛，請於汲、湯陰、內黃、大名諸縣築草壩二十七。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he memorialized that the Wei River was swollen and requested building twenty-seven grass dams in Ji, Tangyin, Neihuang, Daming, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he reported that the Wei River was running high and asked to build twenty-seven grass dams across Ji, Tangyin, Neihuang, Daming, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 又請培鄭州薛家集諸處埽壩。

translations.literal: He also requested strengthening the revetment dams at Xuejiaji in Zhengzhou and other places.
translations.idiomatic: He also sought repairs to the revetment dams at Xuejiaji in Zhengzhou and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 五年，命兼管山東黃河堤工。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered concurrently to oversee Shandong Yellow River dike works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he was put in charge of Shandong Yellow River dikes as well.

sentences.zh: 尋轉吏部侍郎，仍留副總河任。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel but was still retained in the post of Vice Director-General of Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Vice Minister of Personnel while remaining in his river post.

sentences.zh: 六年，疏言：「儀封北岸因水勢衝急，雷家寺上首灘崖刷成支河。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he memorialized: "On the northern bank at Yifeng, because the water's force was violently rushing, the bank cliff above Leisi Temple was scoured into a branch channel.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he reported: "On Yifeng's north bank the fierce current had scoured the cliff above Leisi Temple into a branch channel.

sentences.zh: 請將舊堤加幫，接築土壩，跨斷支河，以防掣溜侵堤。

translations.literal: He requested strengthening the old dike, connecting and building an earthen dam to span and cut off the branch channel, to guard against rushing current invading the dike.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed bolstering the old dike, linking an earthen dam across the branch, and sealing it off to keep diverted current from undermining the main embankment.

sentences.zh: 青龍岡水勢縈紆，將上灣淘作深兜，與下灣相對。

translations.literal: At Qinglong Ridge the water's course wound about; the upper bend was scoured into a deep pocket facing the lower bend.
translations.idiomatic: At Qinglong Ridge the current looped back on itself; the upper bend had been scoured into a deep pool opposite the lower bend.

sentences.zh: 請乘勢開引河，導水東行。

translations.literal: He requested taking advantage of the situation to open a diversion channel and guide the water eastward.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed opening a diversion channel there to turn the flow eastward.

sentences.zh: 」尋擢兵部尚書，調吏部，仍管副總河事。

translations.literal: " Soon he was promoted to Minister of War, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and still directed affairs as Vice Director-General of Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward he was promoted to Minister of War, moved to the Ministry of Personnel, and kept charge of river work as Vice Director-General.

sentences.zh: 奏請培蘭陽耿家寨北堤，下埽簽椿築壩。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting reinforcement of the northern dike at Gengjiazhai in Lanyang, deploying revetments, driving piles, and building dams.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to strengthen the north dike at Gengjiazhai in Lanyang with revetments, piles, and dams.

sentences.zh: 七年，授河南山東河道總督，疏請開荊隆口引河。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed Governor-General of Henan and Shandong River Works and memorialized requesting opening a diversion channel at Jinglong Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he became Governor-General of Henan and Shandong rivers and proposed opening a diversion at Jinglong Mouth.

sentences.zh: 八年，署江南河道總督，疏言：「山水異漲，匯歸駱馬湖，溢運浮黃，河、湖合一。

translations.idiomatic: In year 8, acting as Jiangnan river governor, he reported: "Separate surges of mountain water poured into Luoma Lake, flooding the canal and mingling Yellow River water with the lake.

sentences.zh: 請於山盱周橋以南開壩洩水，並啟高、寶諸堰，分水入江海。

translations.literal: He requested opening dams south of Zhouqiao in Shanxu to discharge water, and also opening the Gaoyan, Bao'ying, and other barrages to divide water into the rivers and sea.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed opening spill dams south of Zhouqiao in Shanxu and opening the Gaoyan, Bao'ying, and other barrages to divert water toward the rivers and sea.

sentences.zh: 高堰山盱石工察有椿腐石欹，順砌卑矮者，應築月壩，加高培實。

translations.literal: Among the stone works at Gaoyan in Shanxu, inspection found rotten piles and tilted stones and stretches where the aligned masonry was low and short; crescent dams should be built and height added with solid fill.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection of the Gaoyan stonework at Shanxu found rotted piles, tilted blocks, and low sections of facing; he called for crescent dams and raised, solid reinforcement.

sentences.zh: 其年久傾圮者，全行改築。

translations.literal: Where long years had brought collapse, the whole should be rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: Sections that had stood for years in ruin should be rebuilt entirely.

sentences.zh: 興工之際，築壩攔水，留舊石工為障。

translations.literal: When work began, dams should be built to hold back water, leaving the old stonework as a barrier.
translations.idiomatic: During construction, temporary dams would hold back the water while the old stonework served as a shield.

sentences.zh: 俟新基築定，再除舊石，仍留舊底二層，以御風浪。

translations.literal: Once the new foundation was firmly built, the old stone would be removed; still two layers of the old base would be kept to withstand wind and waves.
translations.idiomatic: After the new foundation was set, the old facing would come out, but two layers of the original base would remain to resist wind and wave.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「禹王台壩工為江南下游保障。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "The Yu Wang Platform dam works are the safeguard for lower Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: " He also reported: "The Yu Wang Platform dam protects lower Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 沭水源長性猛，壩工受衝。

translations.literal: The Shu River rises far and runs fiercely; the dam works bear the impact.
translations.idiomatic: The Shu River has a long reach and a fierce current, and the dam takes the brunt of it.

sentences.zh: 請於現有竹絡壩二十七丈外，依頂沖形勢，建石工六百餘丈。

translations.literal: Beyond the existing twenty-seven zhang of bamboo-mat dam, he requested building more than six hundred zhang of stonework according to the shape of the head-on impact.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the existing twenty-seven zhang of bamboo-mat revetment he proposed six hundred more zhang of stonework aligned to the direction of the main impact.

sentences.zh: 接連岡阜，仍築土堤，並濬沭河口門，使循故道直趨入海。

translations.literal: Connecting to the hill ridges, earthen dikes should still be built, and the Shu River's mouth dredged so that it would follow its old course straight to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The stonework would tie into the hills, with earthen dikes alongside, and the Shu River mouth would be dredged so the river could run its old channel straight to the sea.

sentences.zh: 」十年，奏揚州芒稻河閘商工草率，改歸官轄，並增設閘官。

translations.literal: " In the tenth year he memorialized that the merchant-built sluice on the Mangdao River at Yangzhou was shoddy; it should be placed under official management and additional sluice officers added.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 10 he reported that the merchant-built Mangdao River sluice at Yangzhou was poorly done; he had it placed under official control and added sluice officers.

sentences.zh: 十二月，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was given the additional title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，授文華殿大學士，兼吏部尚書，仍總督江南河道，予一品封典。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eleventh year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall, concurrently Minister of Personnel, still governing Jiangnan river works, and granted first-rank enfeoffment honors.
translations.idiomatic: In April of year 11 he became Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall and Minister of Personnel, kept charge of Jiangnan rivers, and received first-rank enfeoffment honors.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丁母憂，命在任守制。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he entered mourning for his mother; he was ordered to observe mourning while remaining in post.
translations.idiomatic: In December he began mourning for his mother and was told to remain in office while observing the rites.

sentences.zh: 曾筠奏懇回籍終制，溫詔許之。

translations.literal: Zeng Jun memorialized earnestly asking to return home to complete mourning; a gracious edict granted permission.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jun begged leave to go home and finish mourning properly; the emperor graciously consented.

sentences.zh: 以高斌暫署，仍諭曾筠本籍距淮安不遠，明歲工程，就近協同經理。

translations.literal: Gao Bin was temporarily appointed in his place; the emperor still instructed Zeng Jun that his native place was not far from Huai'an and that for next year's projects he should collaborate nearby in management.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin was named acting governor, but the emperor told Zeng Jun that since his home was near Huai'an he should still help manage the coming year's works from nearby.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月，同高斌奏增築海口辛家蕩堤閘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year he jointly memorialized with Gao Bin to enlarge the dike and sluice at Xinjia Dang at the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In April of year 12 he and Gao Bin proposed enlarging the Xinjia Dang dike and sluice at the estuary.

sentences.zh: 同副總河白鍾山奏修清江龍王閘，濬通鳳陽廠引河。

translations.literal: Together with Vice Director-General Bai Zhongshan he memorialized to repair the Qingjiang Dragon King Sluice and dredge open the Fengyangchang diversion channel.
translations.idiomatic: With Vice Director-General Bai Zhongshan he reported plans to repair the Qingjiang Dragon King Sluice and dredge the Fengyangchang diversion channel.

sentences.zh: 十三年，諭曾筠葬母事畢赴工。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the emperor instructed Zeng Jun to return to work once his mother's burial was finished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 the emperor ordered Zeng Jun back to duty after his mother's funeral.

sentences.zh: 高宗御極，命總理浙江海塘工程。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozong ascended the throne, he was ordered to take overall charge of Zhejiang seawall works.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qianlong Emperor took the throne, he was put in charge of Zhejiang's seawall projects.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，兼浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he also served as Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 1 he also served as governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 尋命改為總督，兼管鹽政。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to be made governor-general and concurrently to manage salt administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made governor-general with oversight of the salt monopoly as well.

sentences.zh: 曾筠條奏鹽政，請改商捕為官役，嚴緝私販，定緝私賞罰。

translations.literal: Zeng Jun submitted detailed memorials on salt policy, requesting changing merchant-led seizure to official enforcement, strictly suppressing private smuggling, and fixing rewards and punishments for smuggling cases.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jun laid out salt reforms: replace merchant patrols with official agents, crack down on smuggling, and set clear rewards and penalties for seizures.

sentences.zh: 地方有搶鹽奸徒，官吏用盜案例參處。

translations.literal: Where local salt-robber villains existed, officials should handle them under the statutes for banditry.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were to prosecute local salt thieves under the banditry statutes.

sentences.zh: 又疏請於海寧築尖山壩，建魚鱗石塘七千四百餘丈。

translations.literal: He also memorialized requesting building the Jianshan dam at Haining and constructing more than seven thousand four hundred zhang of fish-scale stone seawall.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed the Jianshan dam at Haining and more than 7,400 zhang of fish-scale stone seawall.

sentences.zh: 入覲，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: On audience at court he was given the additional title of Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: During an audience at court he was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二年，疏請築淳安淳河石磡。

translations.literal: In the second year he memorialized requesting building a stone embankment on the Chun River at Chun'an.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he proposed a stone embankment on the Chun River at Chun'an.

sentences.zh: 三年，疏請修樂清濱海堤；

translations.literal: In the third year he memorialized requesting repair of the coastal dike at Yueqing;
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he asked to repair the Yueqing coastal dike;

sentences.zh: 又疏請發省城義倉運溫、台諸縣平糶：並從之。

translations.literal: he also memorialized requesting distributing grain from the provincial charity granary for fair-price sale in Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other counties: all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: he also proposed sending grain from the provincial charity granary for fair-price sale in Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other counties; the court approved both requests.

sentences.zh: 尋召入閣治事，以疾請回籍調治。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned to serve in the Grand Council; owing to illness he requested to return home for treatment.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon called into the Grand Council, but illness led him to ask for leave to recuperate at home.

sentences.zh: 上令其子璜歸省，又遣醫診視。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered his son Huang to return and visit him, and also sent physicians to examine and treat him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent his son Huang home to visit and dispatched physicians to attend him.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈少保，賜祭葬，諡文敏，祀浙江賢良祠。

translations.literal: He died; he was posthumously given the title of Junior Guardian, granted funeral sacrifices, given the posthumous name Wenmin, and enshrined in the Zhejiang shrine of worthy officials.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Junior Guardian with state funeral honors, given the posthumous name Wenmin, and enshrined in Zhejiang's hall of worthy ministers.

sentences.zh: 又命視靳輔、齊蘇勒例，一體祠祀。

translations.literal: He was also ordered to be worshipped jointly in the same rites as Jin Fu and Qisuole.
translations.idiomatic: He was also ordered worshipped alongside Jin Fu and Qisuole in the same rites.

sentences.zh: 曾筠在官，視國事如家事。

translations.literal: In office Zeng Jun treated state affairs as household affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In office Zeng Jun handled state business as though it were his own family's concern.

sentences.zh: 知人善任，恭慎廉明，治河尤著績。

translations.literal: He knew men and employed them well; he was respectful, cautious, incorrupt, and clear-minded, and achieved outstanding results especially in river control.
translations.idiomatic: He knew talent and used it well, conducted himself with dignity and integrity, and won his greatest renown in river work.

sentences.zh: 用引河殺險法，前後省庫帑甚鉅。

translations.literal: Using the method of diversion channels to reduce danger, he saved vast sums from the treasury before and after.
translations.idiomatic: His diversion-channel method for easing hazards saved the treasury enormous sums over the years.

sentences.zh: 第三子璜，亦由治河有功，官大學士，繼其武。

translations.literal: His third son Huang likewise, through achievements in river control, rose to Grand Secretary and carried on his work.
translations.idiomatic: His third son Huang also distinguished himself in river work, rose to Grand Secretary, and followed in his footsteps.

sentences.zh: 璜，字尚佐。

translations.literal: Huang, styled Shangzuo.
translations.idiomatic: Huang, courtesy name Shangzuo.

sentences.zh: 幼讀禹貢，曰：「禹治水皆自下而上。

translations.literal: As a child reading the Yu Gong, he said: "Yu controlled the waters entirely from below upward.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy reading the Canon of Yu, he remarked: "Yu tamed the floods by working from downstream upward.

sentences.zh: 蓋下游宣通，水自順流而下。

translations.literal: For when the lower reaches are cleared and open, water naturally flows downward on its own.
translations.idiomatic: Once the lower course is open, the water will flow down on its own."

sentences.zh: 」長老咸驚異。

translations.literal: " The elders were all astonished.
translations.idiomatic: " The elders were all amazed.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，賜舉人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng he was granted the rank of submitted scholar.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 7 he received the rank of presented scholar.

sentences.zh: 八年，成進士，選庶吉士，年裁二十。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was barely twenty years old.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was only twenty.

sentences.zh: 授編修，再遷諭德。

translations.literal: He was appointed compiler and was twice promoted to tutor.
translations.idiomatic: He was made a compiler and soon rose twice to tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，命直南書房。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he was ordered to serve in the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 1 he was assigned to the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 三年，丁父憂，服闋，擢庶子。

translations.literal: In the third year he entered mourning for his father; when mourning ended he was promoted to vice director of the Study.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he mourned his father; when the mourning period ended he was made vice director of the Heir Apparent's study.

sentences.zh: 兩歲四遷左僉都御史。

translations.literal: Within two years he was transferred four times to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Within two years he was promoted four times, reaching Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 九年，奏：「督撫閱兵，祗就趨走應對定將弁能否。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he memorialized: "When governors-general and governors inspect troops, they judge officers' ability only by how they run and answer questions.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he reported: "When governors inspect troops they judge officers only by drill performance and how they answer questions.

sentences.zh: 請近省命大臣，邊省命將軍、副都統，簡閱行伍。

translations.literal: He requested that in nearby provinces ministers be appointed, and in frontier provinces generals and vice commanders-in-chief be appointed, to conduct simplified inspection of the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that near provinces send senior ministers and frontier provinces send generals or vice commanders to conduct proper reviews of the ranks.

sentences.zh: 」是歲令大學士訥親閱河南、山東、江南三省行伍，璜此奏發之也。

translations.literal: " That year the Grand Secretary Neqin was ordered to inspect the ranks in Henan, Shandong, and Jiangnan—the three provinces; this memorial of Huang's had prompted it.
translations.idiomatic: " That year Grand Secretary Neqin was sent to inspect troop quality in Henan, Shandong, and Jiangnan—Huang's memorial had set this in motion.

sentences.zh: 璜侍曾筠行河，習工事。

translations.literal: Huang attended Zeng Jun on river tours and learned engineering work.
translations.idiomatic: Huang accompanied Zeng Jun on river inspection tours and learned the craft of waterworks.

sentences.zh: 奏河工疏築諸事：請浚毛城鋪壩下引河，並於順河集諸地開河引溜，修築黃河岸，留新黃河、韓家堂諸地舊口，洩盛漲，議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized on dredging, building, and other river matters: requesting dredging the diversion channel below the Maochengpu dam, opening channels at Shunheji and other places to draw off current, repairing the Yellow River bank, leaving the old mouths at Xin Huang River, Hanjiatang, and other places to discharge surging floods—all approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He reported on dredging and construction projects: dredge the diversion below Maochengpu dam, cut channels at Shunheji and elsewhere to divert current, repair the Yellow River bank, and keep the old outlets at Xin Huang River and Hanjiatang to spill flood surges; the proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 授大理寺卿。

translations.literal: He was appointed Chief Judge of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chief judge of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in turn to Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十八年十月，黃、淮並漲。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eighteenth year the Yellow and Huai rivers both rose together.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 18 the Yellow and Huai both flooded.

sentences.zh: 璜疏請濬銅山以下、清口以上河身，並仿明劉天和製平底方船，用鐵耙疏沙，修補高堰石工、歸仁堤閘，酌复江南境內減水閘壩。

translations.literal: Huang memorialized requesting dredging the river channel below Tongshan and above Qingkou, also following the Ming official Liu Tianhe in making flat-bottom square boats and using iron rakes to dredge sand, repairing Gaoyan stonework and the Guiren dike sluice, and selectively restoring flood-relief sluices and dams within Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Huang proposed dredging the channel from Tongshan to Qingkou, building flat-bottom square boats like those of the Ming engineer Liu Tianhe fitted with iron rakes to scrape silt, repairing Gaoyan stonework and the Guiren dike gate, and restoring selected flood-relief works in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 尚書舒赫德等被命視河，奏請派熟諳工程大員董理堤防，因令璜偕工部侍郎德爾敏督修。

translations.literal: Ministers Shuhede and others were ordered to inspect the rivers; they memorialized requesting dispatch of senior officials well versed in engineering to direct dike defense, and Huang was thereupon ordered together with Vice Minister of Works De'ermin to supervise repairs.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Shuhede and others were sent to inspect the rivers and recommended veteran engineers to oversee the dikes; Huang was paired with Vice Minister of Works De'ermin to supervise repairs.

sentences.zh: 璜奏：「高堰工程有磚石之殊，年分有新舊之異。

translations.literal: Huang memorialized: "The Gaoyan project has differences between brick and stone, and between new and old sections by year.
translations.idiomatic: Huang reported: "Gaoyan has a mix of brick and stone construction and sections of different ages.

sentences.zh: 今當修砌石工，堤外築攔水壩，並將舊有磚工盡改石工。

translations.literal: Now stonework should be repaired and rebuilt; outside the dike water-blocking dams should be built, and all existing brick works should be wholly changed to stone works.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed rebuilding in stone, erecting water-blocking dams outside the dike, and converting all existing brickwork to stone.

sentences.zh: 石較磚重，椿木應培增。

translations.literal: Stone is heavier than brick; pile timber should be increased and reinforced.
translations.idiomatic: Stone weighs more than brick, so the pilings would need bolstering.

sentences.zh: 舊修石堤用石二進，石後用磚二進，磚與土不相融結，久經風浪，根空基圮，令於磚石後加築灰土三尺，以御沖刷。

translations.literal: In the old stone dike repair, two courses of stone were used and two courses of brick behind the stone; brick and earth did not bond together, and after long exposure to wind and waves the base was hollowed and the foundation collapsed; he ordered adding three chi of lime-earth behind the brick and stone to resist scour.
translations.idiomatic: The old design used two layers of stone faced with two layers of brick behind; brick and earth never bonded well, and years of wind and wave had hollowed the base. He ordered three chi of lime-soil packing behind the brick and stone to resist scour.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「串場河為諸水總匯。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "The Chuanchang River is the general convergence of all waters.
translations.idiomatic: " He also reported: "The Chuanchang River is where all the waters meet.

sentences.zh: 請自石閘南更建閘二，並就舊河道疏濬，直達海口。

translations.literal: He requested building two more sluices south of the stone sluice, and dredging along the old channel straight to the river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed two new sluices south of the existing stone gate and dredging the old channel straight to the estuary.

sentences.zh: 」十九年，奏：「高堰、高澖、龍門、古溝四處深塘兜灣，請修復草壩。

translations.literal: " In the nineteenth year he memorialized: "At the four deep pool bends of Gaoyan, Gaoxian, Longmen, and Gugou, he requested restoring grass dams.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 19 he asked to restore grass dams at the deep pool bends at Gaoyan, Gaoxian, Longmen, and Gugou.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 是年堤工竟，議敘，轉吏部。

translations.literal: That year the dike works were completed; on merit review he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When the dike work finished that year he was rewarded for merit and moved to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以母病，乞假歸。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, because his mother was ill, he requested leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 he took leave to go home when his mother fell ill.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春，上以璜母病癒，授南河副總河，並諭曰：「璜侍父曾筠久任河工，見聞所及，諳練非難。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year, because Huang's mother had recovered from illness, he was appointed Vice Director-General of the Southern Rivers, and the emperor also instructed: "Huang attended his father Zeng Jun for a long time in river work; what he has seen and heard should make proficiency not difficult.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 22, with his mother's health restored, Huang was made Vice Director-General of Southern Rivers. The emperor told him: "You served long at your father Zeng Jun's side on river work; what you observed there should make you more than able.

sentences.zh: 母雖年近八十，常、淮帶水，侭可輕舟迎養，固無異在家侍奉也。

translations.literal: Though his mother is nearly eighty, the Chang and Huai region is threaded with water; he may fully use light boats to bring her for nurturing care—it is truly no different from serving her at home.
translations.idiomatic: Though your mother is nearly eighty, the Changzhou and Huai'an region is crisscrossed by waterways; you can easily bring her by boat to live with you—it is little different from caring for her at home."

sentences.zh: 」四月，上南巡，臨視高堰、清口及徐州諸工。

translations.literal: " In the fourth month the emperor made a southern tour and personally inspected the works at Gaoyan, Qingkou, and Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " In April the emperor toured the south and personally inspected the works at Gaoyan, Qingkou, and Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 以伏汛將至，近河諸地歲頻歉，貧民甚多，諭疏築諸工同時並舉，以工代賑。

translations.literal: Because the summer flood season was approaching, lands near the rivers had suffered frequent poor harvests in recent years and there were very many impoverished people; [the Emperor] directed that dredging and dyke-building projects all be undertaken simultaneously, using work in place of relief.
translations.idiomatic: With the summer floods imminent and repeated crop failures afflicting riparian districts, the poor were numerous; the Emperor ordered all dredging and construction works launched at once as work-for-relief.

sentences.zh: 因璜前奏請於昭關增滾壩、濬支河，南關舊壩改建滾水石壩，即命璜董其事。

translations.literal: In accordance with Huang's earlier memorial requesting overflow dams added at Zhaoguan and branch rivers dredged, and the old dam at Nanguan rebuilt as an overflow stone dam, [the Emperor] immediately ordered Huang to supervise the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Acting on Huang's earlier proposal to add overflow dams at Zhaoguan, dredge branch channels, and replace the old Nanguan dam with a stone overflow weir, the Emperor put Huang in charge of the work.

sentences.zh: 璜奏：「運河東堤減水入下河，經劉莊、伍祐、新興諸場，分注鬥龍、新洋二港歸海。

translations.literal: Huang memorialized: "The flood-releasing waters from the eastern embankment of the Grand Canal enter the lower river, passing through the Liu Zhuang, Wuyou, and Xinxing salterns, and are divided to pour into the Doulong and Xinyang harbors to reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Huang reported: "Floodwater discharged from the Grand Canal's eastern levee flows into the lower river course, runs through the Liu Zhuang, Wuyou, and Xinxing salt fields, and is split between the Doulong and Xinyang outlets before reaching the sea.

sentences.zh: 但劉莊大團閘至新興石閘相距較遠，請於伍祐沿窪口、蔡家港各增建石閘，引水出新洋港。

translations.literal: But from the Great Tuan Sluice at Liu Zhuang to the Stone Sluice at Xinxing the distance is rather great; he requested that stone sluices be added at Wuyou's Yanwakou and Caijiagang respectively, to lead water out through Xinyang Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: However, the stretch from Liu Zhuang's Great Tuan Sluice to Xinxing's stone sluice was too long; he asked that stone gates be built at Yanwakou and Caijiagang in Wuyou to channel water out via Xinyang Harbor.

sentences.zh: 並疏射陽湖港口，使之徑直。

translations.literal: And also dredge the mouth of Sheyang Lake, making it straight and direct.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed dredging the outlet of Sheyang Lake to straighten its course.

sentences.zh: 濬串場河以西孔家溝、岡溝河、皮家河支流凡三。

translations.literal: Dredge three tributaries west of the Chuanchang River: Kongjiagou, Ganggou River, and Pijia River.
translations.idiomatic: Three branch streams west of the Chuanchang River—the Kongjiagou, Ganggou, and Pijia rivers—should also be dredged.

sentences.zh: 此皆下河歸海之路也。

translations.literal: These are all routes by which the lower river reaches the sea.
translations.idiomatic: All of these were channels by which the lower river discharged into the sea.

sentences.zh: 湖河諸水，歸海紆回，歸江迳直。

translations.literal: The waters of the lakes and rivers, in reaching the sea, follow winding courses; in reaching the Jiang they take direct routes.
translations.idiomatic: Lake and river waters took circuitous paths to the sea but straighter routes to the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 多一分入江，即少一分入海。

translations.literal: For every portion more that enters the Jiang, there is one portion less that enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Every extra share diverted into the Yangtze meant one less share reaching the sea.

sentences.zh: 應挑河築壩，使湖河水勢相平，乃將各壩開放。

translations.literal: Channels should be excavated and dams built so that the water levels and momentum of lake and river are equalized; only then should the various dams be opened.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended digging channels and building dams to balance lake and river levels before opening the various spillways.

sentences.zh: 則湖水既減，可為容納來水地。

translations.literal: Then, once the lake water is reduced, it can serve as land to receive incoming water.
translations.idiomatic: That would lower the lake level and leave capacity to hold incoming floodwater.

sentences.zh: 伏秋水盛，洩高郵湖引入運河，出車邏、南關二壩，則歸海水少，下河田廬可無慮矣。

translations.literal: When the autumn flood of the fu season is heavy, releasing Gaoyou Lake water into the Grand Canal and discharging it through the Che'er and Nanguan dams would mean less water returning to the sea, and the fields and dwellings of the lower river need not be worried over.
translations.idiomatic: During the heavy autumn floods, releasing Gaoyou Lake into the canal through the Che'er and Nanguan dams would reduce seaward discharge and spare the farms and homes of the lower river region.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「璜此奏分別緩急，因勢利導，會全局而熟籌之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor instructed: "In this memorial Huang distinguishes urgency and priority, works with the terrain and guides its force, and considers the overall situation with thorough planning.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "Huang's memorial weighs priorities wisely, adapts to the terrain, and shows careful planning for the whole system.

sentences.zh: 改紆為直，移遠為近，濬淺為深，具有條理。

translations.literal: Changing winding into straight, shifting distant into near, and dredging shallow into deep—it has clear method throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Straightening what was crooked, shortening what was distant, deepening what was shallow—it is orderly and well reasoned.

sentences.zh: 即令尹繼善、白鍾山等會璜次第興舉。

translations.literal: [The Emperor] immediately ordered Yin Jishan, Bai Zhongshan, and others to join Huang in carrying out the projects in due sequence.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Yin Jishan, Bai Zhongshan, and others to assist Huang in implementing the plans step by step.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，高郵運河東堤新建石壩工成，奏請酌定水則，車邏、南關二壩過水至三尺五寸，開五里中閘；

translations.literal: " In the eleventh month, the newly built stone dam on the eastern embankment of the Gaoyou section of the Grand Canal was completed; [Huang] memorialized requesting that water regulations be fixed: when water passing over the Che'er and Nanguan dams reached three chi and five cun, the Zhong Sluice five li away should be opened;
translations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh month, the new stone weir on the Gaoyou Canal's eastern levee was finished. Huang asked that operating levels be set: when flow over the Che'er and Nanguan dams reached three feet five inches, the Zhong Sluice five li downstream should open;

sentences.zh: 至五尺，開新建石壩。

translations.literal: When it reached five chi, the newly built stone dam should be opened.
translations.idiomatic: At five feet, the new stone weir should open.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「車邏、南關壩脊高於高郵湖面二尺七寸。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "The crests of the Che'er and Nanguan dams are two chi and seven cun higher than the surface of Gaoyou Lake.
translations.idiomatic: He further reported: "The Che'er and Nanguan weirs stand two feet seven inches above Gaoyou Lake.

sentences.zh: 芒稻閘為湖水歸江第一尾閭，請常年啟放，俾江、湖脈絡貫通。

translations.literal: The Mangdao Sluice is the foremost tail-gate by which lake water returns to the Jiang; he requested that it be kept open throughout the year, so that the Jiang and the lakes might be linked in one continuous network.
translations.idiomatic: As the primary outlet through which lake water returns to the Yangtze, the Mangdao Sluice should remain open year-round to keep river and lake connected.

sentences.zh: 」上深嘉之，從所請，並降旨命勒石閘畔。

translations.literal: " The Emperor greatly praised this, granted the request, and moreover issued an edict ordering that it be inscribed on stone beside the sluice.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor warmly approved, granted the request, and ordered the policy carved in stone beside the sluice.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月，擢工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-third year, [Huang] was promoted to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year twenty-three, he was promoted to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 五月，上下江諸工皆竟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, all projects in the upper and lower Jiang sections were completed.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth month, all upper- and lower-river works were finished.

sentences.zh: 九月，調禮部。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, he was transferred to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, he was moved to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二十四年四月，請在籍終養。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-fourth year, he requested leave to retire to his native place and complete mourning care for his parents.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year twenty-four, he asked to return home and observe filial mourning there.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，詣京師祝上壽。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, he went to the capital to offer birthday congratulations to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-five, he traveled to the capital for the Emperor's birthday celebration.

sentences.zh: 歸至清江浦，奏言：「歸江之路，尚有應籌。

translations.literal: On returning to Qingjiangpu, he memorialized saying: "The route by which water returns to the Jiang still has matters that should be planned.
translations.idiomatic: On his way back through Qingjiangpu, he reported: "More planning is still needed for the Yangtze discharge route.

sentences.zh: 請於金灣壩下開引河，並濬董家溝。

translations.literal: He requested that a diversion channel be opened below the Jinwan Dam, and Dongjiagou dredged as well.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed opening a channel below the Jinwan Dam and dredging Dongjiagou.

sentences.zh: 又以廖家溝、石羊溝、董家溝三壩改低三尺，使與芒稻閘相準。

translations.literal: He also proposed lowering the three dams at Liaojiagou, Shiyanggou, and Dongjiagou by three chi, to align them with the Mangdao Sluice.
translations.idiomatic: He also suggested lowering the weirs at Liaojiagou, Shiyanggou, and Dongjiagou by three feet to match the Mangdao Sluice level.

sentences.zh: 」上命交尹繼善等勘議。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered that the matter be referred to Yin Jishan and others for survey and deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor referred the proposal to Yin Jishan and others for investigation.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，丁母憂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, he entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-nine, he began mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，服闋，署禮部尚書，旋實授。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, when mourning ended, he served as acting Minister of Rites, and soon received substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended in year thirty-two, he served as acting Minister of Rites and was soon confirmed in the post.

sentences.zh: 七月，授河東河道總督，奏：「楊橋大壩為河南第一要工，雖已堵閉，時輒滲漏。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, he was appointed Governor-General of River Conservancy east of the He [Yellow River], and memorialized: "The great Yangqiao Dam is the foremost critical work in Henan; although it has been plugged and closed, seepage still occurs from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he became Governor-General of Eastern River Works and reported: "The Yangqiao dam is Henan's most critical project; though sealed, it still leaks intermittently.

sentences.zh: 而北岸河灘順直，既不能挑引河分溜，大壩迤東又遍地飛沙，不能建越堤。

translations.literal: The northern river beach is straight and smooth, so a diversion channel cannot be excavated to split the flow; east of the great dam the ground is everywhere shifting sand, so an overtopping embankment cannot be built.
translations.idiomatic: The north bank was too straight for a diversion channel, and shifting sand east of the dam made an emergency levee impossible.
