sentences.zh: 請將壩身裹戧培厚，用資完固。

translations.literal: He requested that the body of the dam be wrapped, buttressed, and thickened, to make it complete and solid.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the dam be buttressed and thickened to secure it.

sentences.zh: 」璜每巡河，不避艱險，身先屬吏。

translations.literal: " Whenever Huang inspected the rivers, he did not shun hardship or danger, and took the lead ahead of his subordinate officials.
translations.idiomatic: " On river inspections Huang never shrank from danger and always led his staff from the front.

sentences.zh: 一夕聞虞城工險，馳往。

translations.literal: One evening, hearing that the work at Yucheng was in peril, he galloped there.
translations.idiomatic: One night, hearing that the Yucheng site was in danger, he rode there at once.

sentences.zh: 天甫曉，雨雹交下，下埽岌岌欲崩，從者失色，勸璜姑退。

translations.literal: Just as dawn broke, rain and hail fell together; the lower revetment was tottering on the verge of collapse; those accompanying him turned pale and urged Huang to withdraw for the moment.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak, rain and hail struck; the lower revetment was about to fail. His attendants paled and begged him to retreat.

sentences.zh: 璜立堤上叱曰：「埽去我與俱去！

translations.literal: Huang stood on the dyke and shouted rebuke: "If the revetment goes, I go with it!
translations.idiomatic: Huang stood on the levee and cried: "If the revetment goes, I go with it!

sentences.zh: 」雨雹息，堤卒無恙。

translations.literal: " The rain and hail ceased, and the dyke ultimately remained unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: " When the storm passed, the dyke held.

sentences.zh: 三十三年九月，召授工部尚書，罷直南書房。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirty-third year, he was summoned and appointed Minister of Works, and removed from duty in the Southern Studio.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year thirty-three, he was recalled as Minister of Works and relieved of Southern Studio duty.

sentences.zh: 尋以在河督任未甄別佐雜，左遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: Soon, because while serving as river governor he had not screened and sorted assistant and miscellaneous personnel, he was demoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was demoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief for failing to vet subordinate staff during his river-governorship.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, he was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-six he was made Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，擢尚書，調兵部。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, he was promoted to Minister and transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-eight he was promoted to minister and transferred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 四十年，復調工部。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, he was again transferred to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty he returned to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，調吏部，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and appointed Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-four he moved to the Ministry of Personnel as Associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 初，璜議挽黃河北流仍歸山東故道，入對嘗及之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Huang had proposed turning the Yellow River's northward flow back into its old course in Shandong; when entering audience he had sometimes raised the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Huang had long advocated restoring the Yellow River's northward course to its old Shandong channel and had raised the idea in imperial audiences.

sentences.zh: 是歲河決青龍岡，大學士阿桂視工。

translations.literal: That year the river breached at Qinglonggang, and Grand Secretary Agui went to inspect the works.
translations.idiomatic: That year the river broke at Qinglonggang, and Grand Secretary Agui inspected the site.

sentences.zh: 上以璜議諮阿桂及河督李奉翰，僉謂地北高南低，水性就下；

translations.literal: The Emperor consulted Agui and River Governor Li Fenghan regarding Huang's proposal; all said the land was higher in the north and lower in the south, and water by nature seeks the lower level;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor asked Agui and River Governor Li Fenghan about Huang's plan; all agreed the terrain sloped north to south and water naturally seeks the lowest level;

sentences.zh: 欲導河北注，揣時度勢，斷不能行。

translations.literal: To try to guide the He River northward for discharge, considering the times and weighing the forces involved, could absolutely not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Forcing the Yellow River northward was, given circumstances and terrain, utterly impracticable.

sentences.zh: 上復命廷臣集議，仍謂黃河南徙已久，不可輕議改道，寢其事。

translations.literal: The Emperor again ordered court ministers to gather for deliberation; they still said the Yellow River had shifted south long ago and the course should not lightly be debated for change, and the matter was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor convened the court again, but ministers held that the river's southward shift was too entrenched to reconsider; the proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，加太子太保，在上書房總師傅上行走。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year, he was granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and served above the rank of Chief Tutor in the Upper Studio.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-seven he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with senior status in the Upper Studio.

sentences.zh: 並以璜年老，諭冬令日出後入朝，賜玄狐端罩。

translations.literal: Because Huang was old, [the Emperor] also directed that in winter he might enter court only after sunrise, and bestowed upon him a ceremonial surcoat of black fox fur.
translations.idiomatic: Given his age, Huang was excused from winter court until after sunrise and granted a black-fox formal surcoat.

sentences.zh: 五十年正月，與千叟宴，為漢大臣領班。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fiftieth year, he attended the Feast of a Thousand Elders and led the Han officials.
translations.idiomatic: At the first-month Feast of a Thousand Elders in year fifty, he headed the Han Chinese ministers.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，以老乞休，賜詩慰留。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, citing old age he requested retirement; [the Emperor] bestowed a poem to comfort and retain him.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-one he asked to retire on account of age; the Emperor answered with a consoling poem and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 上幸避暑山莊，命留京辦事。

translations.literal: When the Emperor went to the Mountain Resort for Summer, he ordered [Huang] to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor traveled to the Summer Mountain Resort, Huang was ordered to remain in Beijing to handle affairs.

sentences.zh: 五十五年四月，以璜成進士逾六十年，重與恩榮宴。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifty-fifth year, because Huang had passed sixty years since becoming a jinshi, he was again granted attendance at the Enrong Feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year fifty-five, sixty years after his jinshi degree, Huang was honored again at the Enrong Feast.

sentences.zh: 璜年八十，與高宗同歲生，生日在六月，奏改萬壽節後。

translations.literal: Huang was eighty, born in the same year as the Gaozong Emperor; his birthday fell in the sixth month, and he memorialized requesting it be moved to after the Wan Shou Festival.
translations.idiomatic: At eighty, Huang shared the Emperor's birth year; since his birthday fell in the sixth month, he asked to celebrate it after the imperial birthday.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其知禮，代定八月十九日，賜詩及聯榜、上方珍玩寵之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his sense of propriety, fixed the date on his behalf as the nineteenth day of the eighth month, and favored him with a poem, paired scrolls, and precious curios from the imperial collection.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor admired his tact, set the date as the nineteenth of the eighth month, and honored him with an imperial poem, paired couplets, and rare treasures.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，复賜肩輿入直。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, he was again granted a sedan chair for entering imperial service.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-six he was again allowed a palanquin for palace duty.

sentences.zh: 五十九年七月，卒，年八十有四，命皇八子奠醊，贈太子太師，賜祭葬，諡文恭。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifty-ninth year, he died, aged eighty-four; the Eighth Imperial Son was ordered to offer libations; he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, granted state funeral rites, and given the posthumous title Wengong ["Refined and Respectful"].
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh month of year fifty-nine at eighty-four. The Eighth Prince was sent to offer funeral libations; he was posthumously named Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, granted state funeral honors, and given the posthumous title Wengong.

sentences.zh: 子八，長承謙，進士，官至侍讀，先璜卒。

translations.literal: He had eight sons; the eldest, Cheng Qian, was a jinshi, rose to Reader-in-Waiting, and died before Huang.
translations.idiomatic: He had eight sons. The eldest, Cheng Qian, a jinshi who reached Reader-in-Waiting, predeceased him.

sentences.zh: 族子承恩，舉人，累官至河東河道總督。

translations.literal: A clansman, Cheng En, was a provincial graduate and rose through successive posts to Governor-General of River Conservancy east of the He.
translations.idiomatic: His clansman Cheng En, a provincial graduate, rose to Governor-General of Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 高斌，字右文，高佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，初隸內務府。

translations.literal: Gao Bin, styled Youwen, of the Gao clan, a bondsman of the Bordered Yellow Banner, initially belonged to the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin, courtesy name Youwen, of the Gao clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, began in the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授內務府主事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, he was appointed a secretary of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he was made a secretary in the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 再遷郎中，管蘇州織造。

translations.literal: He was promoted again to director and supervised Suzhou weaving.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to director and put in charge of Suzhou imperial weaving.

sentences.zh: 六年，授廣東布政使，調浙江、江蘇、河南諸省。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was appointed Financial Commissioner of Guangdong and was transferred among the provinces of Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In year six he became Guangdong financial commissioner and served in turn in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷河東副總河。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was transferred to Vice Director-General of River Conservancy east of the He.
translations.idiomatic: In year nine he was made Vice Director-General of Eastern River Works.

sentences.zh: 十年，調兩淮鹽政，兼署江寧織造。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he was transferred to Salt Controller of the Two Huai and also served concurrently as acting supervisor of Jiangning weaving.
translations.idiomatic: In year ten he became Two Huai salt controller and acted concurrently as Jiangning weaving supervisor.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he served as acting Governor-General of Jiangnan River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In year eleven he served as acting Jiangnan river governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，回鹽政任。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he returned to his salt-control post.
translations.idiomatic: In year twelve he returned to his salt post.

sentences.zh: 复署河道總督，培范公堤六萬四千餘丈。

translations.literal: He again served as acting river governor-general and built up the Fan Gong Dike for more than sixty-four thousand zhang.
translations.idiomatic: He again acted as river governor-general and reinforced the Fan Gong Dike for over sixty-four thousand zhang.

sentences.zh: 十三年，回鹽政任。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he returned to his salt-control post.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirteen he returned again to salt administration.

sentences.zh: 旋授江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed Governor-General of Jiangnan River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed Jiangnan river governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，疏請河工搶修工段需用土方，令河兵挑運十之四​​，用民工十之六。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, he memorialized requesting that for emergency repair sections of river works requiring earth, river soldiers be made to transport four-tenths and civilian laborers six-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he proposed that emergency earthworks be carried out with forty percent soldier labor and sixty percent civilian labor.

sentences.zh: 又請葦蕩營採柴均歸廠運。

translations.literal: He also requested that firewood gathered by reed-marsh camps all be transported through depot shipment.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that reed-camp fuel collection be handled through centralized depot transport.

sentences.zh: 又請各州縣河工外解各項悉歸河庫道。

translations.literal: He also requested that all items paid in from prefectures and counties for river works outside [regular appropriations] be turned over entirely to the river treasury circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He further proposed that all supplemental river funds remitted from local counties go to the river treasury circuit.

sentences.zh: 河南永城、江南蕭縣頻年被河患，上命高斌會兩江總督趙弘恩、河南巡撫富德籌疏通之策。

translations.literal: Yongcheng in Henan and Xiaoxian in Jiangnan had suffered river disasters year after year; the Emperor ordered Gao Bin to join with Governor-General Zhao Hong'en of the Two Jiangs and Henan Governor Fude in planning measures for dredging and clearing.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated flooding in Yongcheng, Henan, and Xiaoxian, Jiangnan, the Emperor ordered Gao Bin to work with Governor-General Zhao Hong'en and Henan Governor Fude on relief plans.

sentences.zh: 高斌等奏：「黃河南岸碭山毛城鋪向有減水石壩一，蕭縣王家山有天然減水石閘一，睢寧縣峰山有減水閘四，建自康熙間，誠分黃導淮以水治水之善策。

translations.literal: Gao Bin and others memorialized: "On the south bank of the Yellow River at Maochengpu in Dangshan there had long been one flood-reduction stone dam; at Wangjiashan in Xiaoxian there was one natural flood-reduction stone sluice; at Fengshan in Suining County there were four flood-reduction sluices—all built since the Kangxi reign—and they were truly an excellent policy of dividing the Yellow flow to guide the Huai and governing water with water.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin and colleagues reported: "Since Kangxi, flood works on the Yellow River's south bank—including the Maochengpu stone spillway in Dangshan, Wangjiashan's natural sluice in Xiaoxian, and four sluices at Fengshan in Suining—embodied the sound policy of splitting Yellow River flow to the Huai and fighting water with water.

sentences.zh: 年久淤淺，水發為患。

translations.literal: After many years they silted shallow, and when floods rose they became a source of disaster.
translations.idiomatic: After years of silting, they caused flooding when waters rose.

sentences.zh: 毛城鋪舊有洪溝、巴河二河，為減洩黃水故道。

translations.literal: At Maochengpu there had formerly been two rivers, Honggou and Bahe, which were old channels for reducing and discharging Yellow River water.
translations.idiomatic: Maochengpu once had the Honggou and Bahe channels, former routes for Yellow River spill.

sentences.zh: 閘下地勢，東北偏高，水向南行，漫入祝家口。

translations.literal: Below the sluice the terrain sloped higher in the northeast; water ran southward and spread into Zhujiakou.
translations.idiomatic: Below the sluice the ground rose to the northeast, so water flowed south and flooded Zhujiakou.

sentences.zh: 請俟水涸疏濬二河，並於二河上游開蔣溝河，築祝家口、潘家口二壩。

translations.literal: He requested that when the water dried up the two rivers be dredged, and that upstream of the two rivers the Jianggou River be opened, and dams built at Zhujiakou and Panjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed dredging both channels when waters receded, opening the Jianggou River upstream, and building dams at Zhujiakou and Panjiakou.

sentences.zh: 漳水南流，使盡入蔣溝、洪溝、巴河分流下注，永城、碭山諸縣當無水患。

translations.literal: The Zhang water would flow south, making it all enter Jianggou, Honggou, and Bahe for divided discharge downstream; Yongcheng, Dangshan, and the other counties should then be free of water disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Southward flow through Jianggou, Honggou, and Bahe would divert the Zhang water and protect Yongcheng, Dangshan, and neighboring counties from flooding.

sentences.zh: 王家山天然閘減水會入徐溪口，舊有引河，間有淤淺；

translations.literal: The natural sluice at Wangjiashan discharged flood-reduction water that joined at Xuxikou; there was an old diversion channel, which from time to time silted shallow;
translations.idiomatic: Wangjiashan's natural sluice discharged into Xuxikou via an old channel that had partly silted up;

sentences.zh: 峰山減水四閘，歷年既久，引河亦有淤淺：均應疏濬。

translations.literal: The four flood-reduction sluices at Fengshan, over many years, likewise had diversion channels with silting: all should be dredged.
translations.idiomatic: And Fengshan's four spillway sluices also needed dredging after years of silting.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「淮揚運河自清口至瓜洲三百餘裡，其源為分洪澤湖水入天妃閘，建瓴而下，經淮安、寶應、高郵、揚州以達於江，惟借東西漕堤為障。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "The Huai-Yang section of the Grand Canal, more than three hundred li from Qingkou to Guazhou, takes its source in the division of Hongze Lake water entering the Tianfei Sluice; it pours down like water tipped from a high jar, passing through Huai'an, Baoying, Gaoyou, and Yangzhou to reach the Jiang, relying solely on the eastern and western grain-transport embankments as its barrier.
translations.idiomatic: " He also reported: "The Huai-Yang Canal runs over three hundred li from Qingkou to Guazhou, fed by Hongze Lake through the Tianfei Sluice. The current races downhill through Huai'an, Baoying, Gaoyou, and Yangzhou to the Yangtze, bounded only by the east and west transport levees.

sentences.zh: 請於天妃、正越兩閘之下，相距百餘丈，各建草壩三。

translations.literal: He requested that below the Tianfei and Zhengyue sluices, at intervals of more than a hundred zhang, three rush dams be built at each place.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed building three rush weirs below each of the Tianfei and Zhengyue sluices, spaced about a hundred zhang apart.

sentences.zh: 壩下建正石閘二，越河石閘二。

translations.literal: Below the dams, two main stone sluices and two bypass stone sluices should be built.
translations.idiomatic: Below the weirs he planned two main stone sluices and two bypass stone sluices.

sentences.zh: 又於所建二閘尾各建草壩三。

translations.literal: And at the tail of each of the two sluices built, three rush dams should be built.
translations.idiomatic: Three more rush weirs would be added below each pair of stone sluices.

sentences.zh: 重重關鎖，層層收蓄，則水平溜緩，可禦洪澤湖異漲，亦可減運河水勢。

translations.literal: With lock upon lock and layer upon layer of retention, the water level would be even and the current slow; it could defend against abnormal surges of Hongze Lake and also reduce the force of the Grand Canal's water.
translations.idiomatic: Multiple tiers of controls would slow and store the flow, buffering Hongze Lake surges and easing pressure on the canal.

sentences.zh: 湖水三分入運，七分會黃。

translations.literal: Three parts of lake water would enter the canal, and seven parts would join the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Three-tenths of the lake water would enter the canal and seven-tenths join the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 山盱尾閭天然南北二壩，非洪澤湖異漲不可輕開，使清水全力禦黃；

translations.literal: The natural north and south dams at the tail-gate of Shanyu should not lightly be opened except when Hongze Lake surged abnormally, so that clear water might fully resist the Yellow;
translations.idiomatic: The natural north and south weirs at the Shanyu outlet should open only in extreme Hongze Lake floods, keeping clear water focused against the Yellow River;

sentences.zh: 而高、寶諸湖所受之水，循軌入口，不至泛溢下河。

translations.literal: And the water received by the Gaoyou, Baoying, and other lakes would follow its channels into the inlet and not spread in overflow into the lower river.
translations.idiomatic: While water entering the Gaoyou and Baoying lakes would follow fixed channels instead of flooding the lower river region.

sentences.zh: 則高、寶、興、鹽諸縣民田可免洪湖洩水之患。

translations.literal: Then the civilian fields of Gaoyou, Baoying, Xinghua, Yancheng, and other counties could be spared the disaster of Hongze Lake discharge.
translations.idiomatic: That would protect farmland in Gaoyou, Baoying, Xinghua, Yancheng, and neighboring counties from Hongze Lake spill.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，均議行。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, all [proposals] were approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved and all proposals adopted.

sentences.zh: 御史夏之芳等疏言：「毛城鋪引河一開，則高堰危，淮、揚運道民生可慮。

translations.literal: Censor Xia Zhifang and others memorialized saying: "If the diversion channel at Maochengpu is opened, the high weir will be endangered, and the livelihood of people along the Huai-Yang transport route is a matter of concern.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Xia Zhifang and others warned: "Opening the Maochengpu diversion would endanger the high weir and threaten transport and livelihoods across Huai-Yang.

sentences.zh: 」命高斌會大學士嵇曾筠、副總河劉永澄等詳度。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered Gao Bin to join Grand Secretary Ji Cengyun, Vice Director-General Liu Yongcheng, and others in detailed assessment.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor ordered Gao Bin to consult Grand Secretary Ji Cengyun, Vice Director-General Liu Yongcheng, and others for a thorough review.

sentences.zh: 安徽布政使晏斯盛、廣東學政王安國復請濬海口，又命高斌與宏恩及江蘇巡撫邵基會勘。

translations.literal: Anhui Financial Commissioner Yan Sisheng and Guangdong Education Intendant Wang Anguo again requested dredging the river mouth; [the Emperor] again ordered Gao Bin to join Hong'en and Jiangsu Governor Shao Ji in joint survey.
translations.idiomatic: When Anhui commissioner Yan Sisheng and Guangdong education intendant Wang Anguo also urged dredging the estuary, the Emperor sent Gao Bin with Hong'en and Jiangsu Governor Shao Ji to inspect.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，高斌請入覲。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, Gao Bin requested permission to attend court in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year two, Gao Bin asked to attend court in the capital.

sentences.zh: 趙弘恩內擢戶部尚書，亦詣京師。

translations.literal: Zhao Hong'en, having been selected internally [for promotion], was also appointed Minister of Revenue and likewise went to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hong'en, promoted to Minister of Revenue, also traveled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 上命王大臣集議，並召之芳等皆與。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered princes and ministers to assemble for deliberation, and summoned Zhifang and others—all were to participate.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered princes and ministers to confer and had Zhifang and the others summoned to join them.

sentences.zh: 高斌言：「毛城鋪減水壩康熙十七年靳輔所建，減水歸洪澤湖，助清刷黃。

translations.literal: Gao Bin said: "The flood-relief dam at Maochengpu was built by Jin Fu in the seventeenth year of Kangxi; its discharged water returns to Hongze Lake and helps clear water scour the Yellow [River].
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin argued: "The Maochengpu spillway Jin Fu built in Kangxi 17 directs overflow into Hongze Lake to help clear water scour the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 六十年來，河道民生，均受其益。

translations.literal: For sixty years, both the river course and people's livelihoods have alike benefited from it.
translations.idiomatic: For sixty years it had served both the channel and the people who depended on it.

sentences.zh: 現濬毛城鋪，乃因壩下舊河量加挑濬，使水有所歸，並非開壩。

translations.literal: The present dredging at Maochengpu is because, below the dam, the old river is being dredged in measured addition to give water a place to go; it is not opening the dam.
translations.idiomatic: The current work at Maochengpu merely deepens the old channel below the dam so water has somewhere to go—it is not opening the spillway.

sentences.zh: 況減下之水，紆回曲折六百餘裡，經徐、蕭、睢、宿、靈、虹諸州縣，有楊甿等五湖為之渟蓄。

translations.literal: Moreover, the water discharged below winds and bends for more than six hundred li, passing through the prefectures and counties of Xu, Xiao, Sui, Su, Ling, and Hong; the five lakes including Yangmeng serve to detain and store it.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, discharged water would travel more than six hundred li of winding course through Xu, Xiao, Sui, Su, Ling, and Hong, with lakes such as Yangmeng's five basins to hold it.

sentences.zh: 入湖時即已澄清，無挾沙入湖之患，亦無湖不能容之慮。

translations.literal: By the time it enters the lake it is already clarified; there is no hazard of carrying sand into the lake, nor concern that the lake cannot contain it.
translations.idiomatic: By the time it reached the lake the water would already be clear—no risk of silt entering the lake, and no fear the lake could not absorb it.

sentences.zh: 」之芳等仍執所見，議未決，御史甄之璜奏：「毛城鋪開河，淮、揚百萬之眾，憂慮惶恐。

translations.literal: " Zhifang and others still clung to their views, and deliberation was unresolved. Censor Zhen Zhihuang memorialized: "Opening the river at Maochengpu—among the millions of people in Huai and Yang, there is worry and fear.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhifang and his allies held to their view and the debate remained deadlocked. Censor Zhen Zhihuang memorialized: "Opening the Maochengpu channel has left millions across Huai-Yang anxious and afraid.

sentences.zh: 」鍾衡條奏亦及之。

translations.literal: " In itemized memorial Zhong Heng also addressed it.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhong Heng raised the same issue in a detailed memorial.

sentences.zh: 上卒用高斌議，斥之璜、衡、之芳等。

translations.literal: The Emperor finally adopted Gao Bin's proposal and rebuked Zhihuang, Heng, Zhifang, and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ultimately sided with Gao Bin and reprimanded Zhihuang, Heng, Zhifang, and their allies.

sentences.zh: 高斌復請別開新運口，堵塞舊運口，以避黃河倒灌。

translations.literal: Gao Bin again requested opening a separate new canal mouth and blocking the old canal mouth to avoid backflow from the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin then proposed opening a new canal mouth and closing the old one to keep Yellow River backflow out.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，淮、揚運河工竟，有旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, the Huai-Yang Grand Canal works were completed, and an edict praised [those responsible].
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year three the Huai-Yang canal works were finished and the court issued commendations.

sentences.zh: 四年，上聞時論議高斌所改新運口離黃稍遠，而上游水勢遇黃河異漲，仍不見倒灌，命大學士鄂爾泰乘驛往勘。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Emperor heard contemporaries discuss that the new canal mouth Gao Bin had changed lay somewhat farther from the Yellow River, yet when upstream water met abnormal surges of the Yellow River there was still no backflow; he ordered Grand Secretary Ortai to travel post-haste to survey.
translations.idiomatic: In year four the Emperor heard officials note that Gao Bin's new canal mouth, though set farther from the Yellow River, still showed no backflow even when upstream flows met exceptional Yellow River surges. He sent Grand Secretary Ortai post-haste to inspect.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰仍主開新運口，如高斌議。

translations.literal: Ortai still advocated opening the new canal mouth, as in Gao Bin's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai still favored opening the new mouth, agreeing with Gao Bin.

sentences.zh: 八月，高斌入覲，命便道與直隸總督孫嘉淦、總河顧琮會勘直隸河道。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Gao Bin came to audience; he was ordered, by the way, to join Zhili Governor-General Sun Jiagan and Director-General Gu Cong in joint survey of Zhili river works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Gao Bin attended court and was ordered to inspect Zhili river works en route with Governor-General Sun Jiagan and Director-General Gu Cong.

sentences.zh: 六年，奏言：「黃河自宿遷下至清河，河流湍急，內逼運河，脣齒相依。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he memorialized saying: "From Suqian down to Qinghe, the Yellow River runs swift and urgent, pressing inward on the Grand Canal—they depend on each other like lips and teeth.
translations.idiomatic: In year six he memorialized: "From Suqian down to Qinghe the Yellow River runs fast and presses against the Grand Canal—they stand or fall together like lips and teeth.

sentences.zh: 請培運河南岸縷堤，作為黃河北岸遙堤。

translations.literal: I request strengthening the continuous dike on the south bank of the canal to serve as a remote dike on the north bank of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to raise the continuous levee on the canal's south bank to serve as a distant levee on the Yellow River's north bank.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「江都瓜河地勢卑下，請量改口門，別濬越河，以減淮水入瓜河分數。

translations.literal: " He also said: "The terrain of Guan River in Jiangdu is low; I request adjusting the sluice gate in measured fashion and dredging a separate overflow channel to reduce the share of Huai water entering Guan River.
translations.idiomatic: " He also urged altering the Jiangdu Guan River sluice and dredging a separate overflow channel to reduce how much Huai water entered Guan River.

sentences.zh: 」又言鎮江南岸埽工宜改磚工。

translations.literal: " He also said that the revetment works on the south bank at Zhenjiang should be changed to brick works.
translations.idiomatic: " He further recommended replacing Zhenjiang's south-bank fascine revetments with brickwork.

sentences.zh: 均下部議行。

translations.literal: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All proposals were referred to the ministries and approved.

sentences.zh: 調直隸總督，兼管總河。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Zhili Governor-General and concurrently directed the Grand Canal administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor-general of Zhili while retaining charge of the canal administration.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「永定河惟在尾閭通暢，請於三角淀旁開引河，下接大清河老河頭，上接鄭家樓水口。

translations.literal: He memorialized saying: "The Yongding River depends only on unobstructed outflow at its tail-gate; I request opening a diversion channel beside Sanjiao Marsh, connecting below to the old head of the Daqing River and above to the water mouth at Zhengjialou.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that the Yongding depended on an unobstructed outlet and proposed a diversion channel beside Sanjiao Marsh, tying the Daqing River's old head downstream to the Zhengjialou intake upstream.

sentences.zh: 挑去積土，即於北岸圈築坡埝，以防北軼。

translations.literal: Remove accumulated earth, and immediately on the north bank enclose and build slope embankments to guard against overflow to the north.
translations.idiomatic: Dredged spoil would be removed and slope embankments built on the north bank to block northern overflow.

sentences.zh: 南岸亦量為接築，以遏南溜。

translations.literal: On the south bank likewise build connecting works in measured fashion to check the southern current.
translations.idiomatic: Similar works on the south bank would check the southern current.

sentences.zh: 下口河脣，隨時疏通。

translations.literal: The river lip at the lower mouth should be cleared at all times.
translations.idiomatic: The lower outlet would be kept dredged as needed.

sentences.zh: 至上游應籌分洩，請於南岸雙營，北岸胡林店、小惠家莊各增建三合土滾壩一；

translations.literal: As for upstream, overflow diversion should be planned; I request at Shuangying on the south bank and at Hulindian and Xiaohuijiazhuang on the north bank each adding one rolling dam of tricomposite earth;
translations.idiomatic: Upstream he proposed adding tricomposite rolling spillways at Shuangying on the south bank and at Hulindian and Xiaohuijiazhuang on the north.

sentences.zh: 並減堤高，使卑於壩。

translations.literal: And reduce the dike height so it is lower than the dam.
translations.idiomatic: Levee heights would be lowered so they stood below the spillways.

sentences.zh: 南岸郭家堤舊草壩應一律修築如式。

translations.literal: The old grass dam at Guojia Embankment on the south bank should uniformly be repaired and built to pattern.
translations.idiomatic: The old grass dam at Guojia Embankment on the south bank would be rebuilt to the same standard.

sentences.zh: 」七年，淮、揚水災，上命高斌及侍郎週學健會總督德沛等治賑。

translations.literal: " In the seventh year, Huai and Yang suffered flood disaster; the Emperor ordered Gao Bin and Vice Minister Zhou Xuejian to join Governor-General De Pei and others in relief administration.
translations.idiomatic: " In year seven floods struck Huai-Yang, and the Emperor sent Gao Bin and Vice Minister Zhou Xuejian with Governor-General De Pei to organize relief.

sentences.zh: 事畢，還直隸，復奏言：「永定河上游為桑乾河，自山西大同至直隸西寧，兩岸可各開渠灌田。

translations.literal: When matters were finished, he returned to Zhili and again memorialized saying: "The upper reaches of the Yongding River are the Sanggan River; from Datong in Shanxi to Xining in Zhili, channels can be opened on both banks to irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: After relief work he returned to Zhili and reported that the Yongding's upper stream, the Sanggan, could be ditched on both banks from Datong in Shanxi to Xining in Zhili for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 自西寧石閘村入山，經宣化黑龍灣、懷來和合堡、宛平沿河口，兩山夾峙，一線中趨。

translations.literal: From Shizha Village at Xining entering the mountains, passing Xuanhua Heilongwan, Huailai Hehe Fort, and Yanping along the river mouth—two mountains flank and press in, and [the river] rushes through a single line in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: From Shizha Village at Xining the river enters the mountains through Heilongwan in Xuanhua, Hehe Fort in Huailai, and the Yanping gorge, where two ranges squeeze it into a single thread.

sentences.zh: 若於山口取巨石錯落堆疊，仿竹絡壩之意，為玲瓏水壩，以殺其洶湧，則下游河患可減。

translations.literal: If at the mountain pass large stones are taken and stacked staggered, following the idea of the bamboo-cage dam, to make an openwork water dam that kills its surging force, then downstream river hazards can be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He suggested stacking boulders at the gorge in the manner of bamboo-cage weirs to form an openwork dam that would break the torrent and ease flooding downstream.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，均議行。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, all [proposals] were approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved and all proposals adopted.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year, he was given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year ten he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五月，授吏部尚書，仍管直隸水利、河道工程。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, he was appointed Minister of Personnel, while still overseeing Zhili waterworks and river engineering.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he became Minister of Personnel while retaining charge of Zhili waterworks and river projects.

sentences.zh: 十二月，命協辦大學士、軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, he was ordered to serve as assistant Grand Secretary with duties in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was assigned to assist as Grand Secretary and serve in the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 十一年，御史楊開鼎劾南河河道總督白鍾山河決匿災不報，命高斌往江南會總督尹繼善按治，白鍾山坐奪官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Censor Yang Kaiding impeached Southern Canal Director-General Bai Zhongshan for breaching the dike and concealing the disaster without reporting; the Emperor ordered Gao Bin to go to Jiangnan and join Governor-General Yin Jishan in investigation and punishment; Bai Zhongshan was stripped of office on conviction.
translations.idiomatic: In year eleven Censor Yang Kaiding accused Southern Canal director Bai Zhongshan of hiding a breach. Gao Bin was sent to Jiangnan with Governor-General Yin Jishan to investigate, and Bai was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「淮、黃二瀆，每年伏秋水漲，以老壩口水志為準則。

translations.literal: He memorialized saying: "The Huai and Yellow channels—each year when summer-autumn water rises, take the water gauge at Laoba Mouth as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that summer-autumn floods on the Huai and Yellow should be measured against the water gauge at Laoba Mouth.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年最大，水志連底水一丈四尺七寸，當以此較量每年水勢。

translations.literal: The highest was in the seventh year of Qianlong: the gauge including bottom water was one zhang, four chi, and seven cun; this should be used to compare the water force each year.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianlong 7 peak—one zhang, four chi, and seven cun including bottom water—should serve as the benchmark for each year's flows.

sentences.zh: 各處閘壩開閉，應以就近石工水漲尺寸為度。

translations.literal: Opening and closing sluices and dams at each place should take the nearby stone-work flood gauge measurements as the measure.
translations.idiomatic: Sluices and dams should open and close according to the nearest stone gauge readings.

sentences.zh: 」運河水漲，又命高斌往勘。

translations.literal: " When the Grand Canal water rose, he was again ordered to go survey.
translations.idiomatic: " When the canal flooded again, Gao Bin was sent to inspect.

sentences.zh: 疏陳培六塘河謝家莊、龍溝口諸處堤堰，濬中墩河、項家衝東門河；

translations.literal: In a memorial he set forth strengthening dikes and dams at Xiejiazhuang, Longgoukou, and other places on the Liutang River, and dredging the Zhongdun River and Xiangjiachong East Gate River;
translations.idiomatic: He proposed strengthening levees at Xiejiazhuang and Longgoukou on the Liutang River and dredging the Zhongdun and Xiangjiachong East Gate channels;

sentences.zh: 又疏請豁免海州、沭陽​​、贛榆諸縣逋賦，及板浦、徐瀆、中正、莞瀆、臨洪、興莊諸場折價帶徵銀：並從之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized requesting exemption of overdue taxes in Haizhou, Shuyang, Ganyu, and other counties, and commuted supplementary silver levies at the salt fields of Banpu, Xuxu, Zhongzheng, Guanxu, Linhong, and Xingzhuang: all were granted.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to remit arrears in Haizhou, Shuyang, Ganyu, and neighboring counties and to adjust supplementary salt-field levies at Banpu, Xuxu, Zhongzheng, Guanxu, Linhong, and Xingzhuang—all approved.

sentences.zh: 高斌嘗謂黃水宜合不宜分，清水宜蓄不宜洩，惟規度湖河水勢，視其縮盈以定蓄洩，方不至泛溢阻礙為民害。

translations.literal: Gao Bin once said: Yellow water should be combined, not divided; clear water should be stored, not discharged—only by planning the force of lake and river water and fixing storage and release according to contraction and fullness can overflow and obstruction be avoided to harm the people.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin held that Yellow River water should be kept unified rather than split, and clear water stored rather than released freely—only by reading lake and river levels and adjusting storage and discharge could flooding and blockage be prevented.

sentences.zh: 諸所籌畫，皆可循守。

translations.literal: All his plans could be followed and maintained.
translations.idiomatic: His designs were sound enough to endure.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月，授文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year, he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Sources.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year twelve he was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Sources.

sentences.zh: 四月，命往江南同河道總督週學健督理防汛。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, he was ordered to go to Jiangnan with Canal Director-General Zhou Xuejian to supervise flood defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was sent to Jiangnan with Canal Director-General Zhou Xuejian to oversee flood defense.

sentences.zh: 五月，直隸水利工竟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Zhili waterworks were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Zhili water projects were finished.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命偕左都御史劉統勳如山東治賑。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he was ordered to accompany Left Censor-in-Chief Liu Tongxun to Shandong for relief administration.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirteen he was sent to Shandong with Left Censor-in-Chief Liu Tongxun to organize famine relief.

sentences.zh: 又命偕總督顧琮如浙江按巡撫常安婪賄狀，高斌等頗不欲窮治。

translations.literal: He was also ordered to accompany Governor-General Gu Cong to Zhejiang to investigate Governor Chang An's greedy-bribery case; Gao Bin and others were quite unwilling to pursue it to the end.
translations.idiomatic: He was also sent with Governor-General Gu Cong to Zhejiang to investigate Governor Chang An for graft, though Gao Bin and the others were reluctant to press the case.

sentences.zh: 上又遣大學士訥親往按，責高斌模棱，下吏議，奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: The Emperor again dispatched Grand Secretary Neqin to investigate, blamed Gao Bin for equivocation, referred him to the officials for deliberation, stripped him of office, but ordered him to remain in post.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then sent Grand Secretary Neqin, faulted Gao Bin for hedging, had him tried, stripped of rank, but left him in office.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，週學健得罪，命兼管江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month, Zhou Xuejian was punished; [Gao Bin] was ordered concurrently to direct the Southern Canal governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month Zhou Xuejian fell from favor and Gao Bin was given concurrent charge of the southern canal administration.

sentences.zh: 尋以籍學健家產徇私瞻顧，奪大學士，仍留河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon because he had registered Zhou Xuejian's family property and showed partiality in looking after [him], his Grand Secretary title was stripped, but he remained Canal Director-General.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he lost his Grand Secretary title for having inventoried Zhou Xuejian's estate in a show of favoritism, though he kept the canal post.

sentences.zh: 十六年三月，上南巡，命仍以大學士銜管河道總督事。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixteenth year, when the Emperor toured the south, [Gao Bin] was ordered still to administer canal director-general affairs with the rank of Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: During the Emperor's southern tour in the third month of year sixteen, Gao Bin was restored to Grand Secretary rank while directing the canal administration.

sentences.zh: 閏五月，暫管兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month, he temporarily directed the Two Jiangs Governor-Generalship.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month he temporarily took charge of the Two Jiangs governor-generalship.

sentences.zh: 八月，盱南陽武漫工未合龍，詔往相度修築，命未下，高斌奏請馳赴協辦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the overflow works at Xuyang and Wuzi had not yet been closed; an edict was issued to go survey and repair—before the order arrived, Gao Bin memorialized requesting to rush there to assist.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Xuyang and Wuzi overflow works remained unclosed. Before orders reached him, Gao Bin volunteered to ride there at once.

sentences.zh: 上獎其急公任事，得大臣體。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his urgent public service and meeting the bearing of a great minister.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his readiness to serve and called it worthy of a senior minister.

sentences.zh: 十一月，工竟，命同侍郎汪由敦勘天津諸處河工。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the works were completed; he was ordered together with Vice Minister Wang Youdun to survey river works at Tianjin and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, when the project was finished, he was sent with Vice Minister Wang Youdun to inspect Tianjin river works.

sentences.zh: 十七年，年七十，賜詩。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, at age seventy, he was granted a poem.
translations.idiomatic: In year seventeen, on his seventieth birthday, the Emperor granted him a poem.

sentences.zh: 十八年，洪澤湖溢，邵伯運河二閘衝決，高郵、寶應諸縣被水，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Hongze Lake overflowed; two sluices of the Shaobo Canal were breached; Gaoyou, Baoying, and other counties were inundated; the ministries were ordered to deliberate severely.
translations.idiomatic: In year eighteen Hongze Lake overflowed, two Shaobo Canal sluices broke, and Gaoyou and Baoying were flooded—triggering a harsh ministerial review.

sentences.zh: 學習河務布政使富勒赫奏劾南河虧帑，命署尚書策楞​​、尚書劉統勳往按。

translations.literal: Fulehe, Financial Commissioner learning river affairs, memorialized impeaching deficits in the southern canal treasury; Acting Minister Celeng and Minister Liu Tongxun were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Fulehe, a financial commissioner learning river affairs, accused the southern canal administration of treasury shortfalls, and Acting Minister Celeng and Minister Liu Tongxun were sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 策楞等疏發外河同知陳克濟、海防同知王德宣虧帑狀；

translations.literal: Celeng and others memorialized exposing Sub-prefect Chen Keji of the Outer River and Coastal Defense Sub-prefect Wang Dexuan for treasury deficits;
translations.idiomatic: Celeng and his team exposed treasury embezzlement by Outer River sub-prefect Chen Keji and coastal sub-prefect Wang Dexuan;

sentences.zh: 並及洪澤湖水溢，通判週冕未為備，水至不能禦，不即奏劾狀。

translations.literal: And also [addressed] Hongze Lake overflow—Assistant Prefect Zhou Mian had made no preparations; when water came he could not defend, and did not immediately memorialize impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: They also reported that when Hongze Lake overflowed, Assistant Prefect Zhou Mian had failed to prepare, could not hold the flood, and did not report promptly.

sentences.zh: 上責高斌徇縱，與協辦河務張師載並奪官，留工效力贖罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor blamed Gao Bin for indulgence, and together with co-director of river affairs Zhang Shizai stripped them of office, keeping them at the works to serve in redemption of guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor blamed Gao Bin for lax supervision and, with co-director Zhang Shizai, stripped both of rank while keeping them on the works to atone.

sentences.zh: 九月，黃河決銅山張家路，南注靈、虹諸縣，歸洪澤湖，奪淮而下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Yellow River broke at Zhangjialu in Tongshan, poured south into Ling, Hong, and other counties, returned to Hongze Lake, and seized the Huai River downstream.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Yellow River broke at Zhangjialu in Tongshan, surged south through Ling and Hong counties into Hongze Lake, and captured the Huai channel downstream.

sentences.zh: 上以秋汛已過，何至衝漫河堤，責高斌命往銅山勒限堵塞。

translations.literal: The Emperor, [saying] the autumn flood season had already passed—how could the river dike have been breached—blamed Gao Bin and ordered him to go to Tongshan with a fixed deadline to block it.
translations.idiomatic: Noting the autumn flood had passed, the Emperor asked how the levee could have failed, blamed Gao Bin, and ordered him to Tongshan to seal the breach by deadline.

sentences.zh: 策楞尋奏同知李敦、守備張賓侵帑誤工狀，上命斬燉、賓，縶高斌、張師載使視行刑，仍傳旨釋之。

translations.literal: Celeng soon memorialized Sub-prefect Li Dun and Garrison Commander Zhang Bin for embezzling funds and delaying works; the Emperor ordered Li Dun and Zhang Bin beheaded, bound Gao Bin and Zhang Shizai to witness the execution, yet still transmitted an edict releasing them.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng then reported sub-prefect Li Dun and garrison commander Zhang Bin for embezzlement and negligence. The Emperor ordered their execution, had Gao Bin and Zhang Shizai bound to watch, then sent word to release them.

sentences.zh: 二十年三月，卒於工次。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twentieth year, he died at the works site.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year twenty he died on the construction site.

sentences.zh: 予內大臣銜，發內庫銀一千治喪。

translations.literal: He was granted the rank of Inner Minister; one thousand taels from the inner treasury were issued for funeral arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously given Inner Minister rank and one thousand taels from the inner treasury for his funeral.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，上南巡，諭曰：「原任大學士、內大臣高斌，任河道總督時頗著勞績。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, during the Emperor's southern tour, he instructed: "Former Grand Secretary and Inner Minister Gao Bin, while serving as Canal Director-General, achieved considerable merit.
translations.idiomatic: During the southern tour in year twenty-two the Emperor said: "Former Grand Secretary and Inner Minister Gao Bin served notably as canal director-general.

sentences.zh: 即如毛城鋪所以分洩黃流，高斌設立徐州水志，至七尺方開。

translations.literal: Take Maochengpu for diverting Yellow flow—Gao Bin established the Xuzhou water gauge: only at seven chi was it to be opened.
translations.idiomatic: Maochengpu, for example, was meant to spill Yellow River flow, and Gao Bin set the Xuzhou gauge to open only at seven chi.

sentences.zh: 後人不用其法，遂致黃弱沙淤，隱貽河患。

translations.literal: Later men did not use his method, and consequently the Yellow grew weak with sand silting—secretly bequeathing river hazards.
translations.idiomatic: Later officials ignored his methods, weakening the Yellow River with silt and storing up future trouble.

sentences.zh: 其於黃河兩岸汕刷支河，每歲冬季必率廳汛填築。

translations.literal: Regarding the scoured branch channels on both banks of the Yellow River, every winter he invariably led the sub-office flood-defense posts in filling and building them up.
translations.idiomatic: Each winter he led local flood-defense offices in rebuilding scoured branch channels along both Yellow River banks.

sentences.zh: 近年工員疏忽，因有孫家集奪溜之事。

translations.literal: In recent years the engineering staff were negligent, and therefore came the incident of Sunjiaji seizing the current.
translations.idiomatic: Recent neglect by engineers led to the Sunjiaji channel capture.

sentences.zh: 至三滾壩洩洪湖盛漲，高斌堅持堵閉，下游州縣屢獲豐收。

translations.literal: As for the Three Rolling Dams discharging Hongze Lake's great surge—Gao Bin firmly insisted on blocking and closing; downstream prefectures and counties repeatedly obtained rich harvests.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Rolling Dams threatened to spill Hongze Lake's peak floods, Gao Bin insisted on keeping them closed, and downstream counties reaped repeated harvests.

sentences.zh: 功在民生，自不可沒。

translations.literal: His merit to people's livelihoods cannot be effaced.
translations.idiomatic: His service to the people could not be denied.

sentences.zh: 癸酉張家路及運河河閘之決，則其果於自信，抑且年邁自滿之失。

translations.literal: The breaches at Zhangjialu in the guiyou year and the canal sluices were his fault of being bold in self-confidence, and moreover the failing of old age and self-satisfaction.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhangjialu and canal sluice failures in guiyou year sprang from overconfidence and the complacency of old age.

sentences.zh: 在本朝河臣中，即不能如靳輔，較齊蘇勒、嵇曾筠有過無不及。

translations.literal: Among river officials of this dynasty, even if he cannot match Jin Fu, compared with Qi Sulei and Ji Cengyun he had shortcomings but no lack of achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Among Qing canal ministers he fell short of Jin Fu, yet stood no lower than Qi Sulei or Ji Cengyun.

sentences.zh: 可與靳輔、齊蘇勒、嵇曾筠同祀，使後之司河務者知所激勸。

translations.literal: He may be worshipped together with Jin Fu, Qi Sulei, and Ji Cengyun, so that future managers of river affairs may know what to emulate and encourage.
translations.idiomatic: He deserved to be enshrined with Jin Fu, Qi Sulei, and Ji Cengyun as an example for future canal officials.

sentences.zh: 」二十三年，賜諡文定。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-third year, he was granted the posthumous name Wending.
translations.idiomatic: " In year twenty-three he received the posthumous name Wending.

sentences.zh: 御製懷舊詩，列五督臣中。

translations.literal: An imperial commemorative poem placed him among the five supervising ministers.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial poem in his memory ranked him among five great canal governors.

sentences.zh: 命祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: He was ordered worshipped in the Temple of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined in the Temple of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 子高恆，高恆子高樸，皆坐事獲譴，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Gao Heng, and Gao Heng's son Gao Pu, both were punished for offenses and have their own biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gao Heng and grandson Gao Pu were both punished for misconduct and have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 上復錄高斌孫高杞授內務府郎中。

translations.literal: The Emperor again enrolled Gao Bin's grandson Gao Qi and appointed him director in the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor later restored Gao Bin's grandson Gao Qi as a director in the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 從子高晉。

translations.literal: His nephew Gao Jin.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew was Gao Jin.

sentences.zh: 高晉，字昭德。

translations.literal: Gao Jin, style name Zhaode.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin, whose style was Zhaode.

sentences.zh: 父述明，涼州總兵。

translations.literal: His father Shuming was commander at Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shuming commanded at Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 高晉初授山東泗水知縣，累遷安徽布政使，兼江寧織造。

translations.literal: Gao Jin was first appointed magistrate of Sishui in Shandong, was promoted through offices to Financial Commissioner of Anhui, and concurrently managed Jiangning weaving.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin began as magistrate of Sishui in Shandong, rose to Anhui financial commissioner, and concurrently oversaw Jiangning imperial weaving.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，擢安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong, he was promoted to Governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 he became governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，上南巡視河，命高晉協辦徐州黃河兩岸堤工。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, when the Emperor toured the south to inspect the river, he ordered Gao Jin to assist in the dike works on both banks of the Yellow River at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the southern tour in year twenty-two the Emperor put Gao Jin in charge of levee work on both banks of the Xuzhou Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 高晉奏言：「鳳、潁災區諸工並舉，米價日昂，動工程銀三萬兩購米，尚慮不敷。

translations.literal: Gao Jin memorialized saying: "In the disaster areas of Feng and Ying, many works proceed together; rice prices rise daily; even thirty thousand taels of engineering silver for buying rice may still be insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin reported: "With disaster relief and construction underway together in Feng and Ying, rice prices were climbing daily; even thirty thousand taels for grain might not suffice.

sentences.zh: 上念淮徐海道諸工，截漕二十萬石平糶。

translations.literal: The Emperor, mindful of the works on the Huai, Xu, and Haizhou routes, diverted two hundred thousand shi of tribute grain for sale at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of works along the Huai, Xu, and coastal routes, the Emperor diverted two hundred thousand shi of tribute grain for sale at fair prices.

sentences.zh: 請分五萬濟上江各工。

translations.literal: [Gao Jin] requested dividing fifty thousand [shi] to aid works in upper Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin asked that fifty thousand shi be allocated to projects in upper Jiang.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " [The request] was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 工竟，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: When the works were completed, he was given the additional title Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished he was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，遷江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, he was transferred to Southern Canal Director-General.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-six he became southern canal director-general.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「高、寶、興、泰積年被水，上命封南關、車邏等壩，於金灣壩下濬引河，洩水歸江，使洪澤湖、運河之水不致漫壩東注。

translations.literal: He memorialized saying: "Gaoyou, Baoying, Xinghua, and Taizhou have been inundated year after year; the Emperor ordered sealing the dams at Nanguan, Cheluo, and others, dredging a diversion channel below Jinwan Dam to discharge water back to the river, so that water of Hongze Lake and the Grand Canal would not overflow the dam and pour eastward.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that Gaoyou, Baoying, Xinghua, and Taizhou had flooded repeatedly. The Emperor ordered the Nanguan and Cheluo dams sealed and a diversion channel dredged below Jinwan Dam to send water back to the river and keep Hongze Lake and canal flows from spilling east over the levees.

sentences.zh: 下河各縣支河汊港及田間積水，均匯入串場河，北至鹽城石、天妃等閘，出新洋港。

translations.literal: Branch rivers, inlet harbors, and accumulated field water in the lower-river counties all converge into the Chuanchang River, north to the sluices at Shicheng and Tianfei in Yancheng, exiting at Xinyang Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Branch streams, inlets, and field water from lower-river counties were channeled into the Chuanchang River, north through Yancheng's Shicheng and Tianfei sluices to Xinyang Harbor.

sentences.zh: 又自興化白駒、青龍、八社、大團等閘出鬥龍港，分二道歸海。

translations.literal: Also from the sluices at Baiju, Qinglong, Bashe, and Datuan in Xinghua, [water] exits through Doulong Harbor, dividing into two routes to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Water also left Xinghua through the Baiju, Qinglong, Bashe, and Datuan sluices into Doulong Harbor and then split into two sea routes.

sentences.zh: 惟下河形如釜底，積澇驟難消涸。

translations.literal: Only the lower river is shaped like the bottom of a cauldron; accumulated flooding is hard to drain away quickly.
translations.idiomatic: But the lower river lay like the bottom of a pot, and standing floodwater drained slowly.

sentences.zh: 請浚興化迤南丁溪、小梅二閘引河使出王家港，興化迤北上岡、北草堰、陳家衝三閘引河，使匯射陽湖，增二道歸海，俾數州縣積水節節流通，沮洳漸成沃壤。

translations.literal: I request dredging the diversion channels of the two sluices at Dingxi and Xiaomei south of Xinghua so water exits through Wangjia Harbor; and the diversion channels of the three sluices at Shanggang, Beicaoyan, and Chenjiachong north of Xinghua, so water converges into Sheyang Lake, adding two routes to the sea, enabling accumulated water in several prefectures and counties to flow stage by stage, and marsh gradually to become fertile soil.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to dredge diversion channels at Dingxi and Xiaomei south of Xinghua to Wangjia Harbor, and at Shanggang, Beicaoyan, and Chenjiachong north of Xinghua into Sheyang Lake, adding two sea outlets so floodwater across several counties could drain step by step and waterlogged land gradually turn fertile.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: "] The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，授內大臣，奏言：「運河歸江，邵伯以下舊設六閘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Interior and memorialized: "The Grand Canal returns to the river; below Shaobo six sluices were formerly established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 he was made an inner court minister and memorialized: "Where the Grand Canal joins the Yangtze, six sluices had long stood below Shaobo.

sentences.zh: 自鹽河分流下注，請將六閘金門量為展寬。

translations.literal: Since the Salt River divides and flows down, I request that the golden gates of the six sluices be appropriately widened.
translations.idiomatic: With the Salt River now sending a divided flow downstream, he asked that the sluice gates be widened as needed.

sentences.zh: 又鹽河舊設中、南、北各二閘，應留北二閘以濟鹽、運。

translations.literal: Further, the Salt River formerly had two sluices each in the middle, south, and north sections; the northern two sluices should be retained to assist salt transport and grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: The Salt River had also had two sluices each on its middle, southern, and northern reaches; he proposed keeping the northern pair to serve both salt and grain transport.

sentences.zh: 南、中二閘過水遲滯，應添建石壩，接長土堤，酌挑引河，俾高、寶湖水歸江益暢。

translations.literal: The southern and middle two sluices slow the passage of water; stone dams should be added, earthen levees extended, and diversion channels selectively dredged, so that water from Gaoyou and Baoying lakes returns to the river more freely.
translations.idiomatic: Water backed up at the southern and middle sluices, so he called for stone dams, extended levees, and selected dredging of diversion channels to speed Gaoyou and Baoying lake water back to the river.

sentences.zh: 」二十八年，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-eighth year, he was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 28 he was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，奏言：「清口以上桃、宿等廳，專受黃水；

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, he memorialized: "Above Qingkou, the offices at Taoyuan, Suxian, and so on receive Yellow River water exclusively;
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 he reported: "Above Qingkou, the Taoyuan and Suxian offices take only Yellow River water;

sentences.zh: 清口東壩以下，淮、黃合流，至雲梯關迤東歸海。

translations.literal: Below the eastern dam at Qingkou, the Huai and Yellow rivers merge, reaching Yunti Pass and then flowing east to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Below Qingkou's eastern dam the Huai and Yellow merge and run east through Yunti Pass to the sea.

sentences.zh: 北岸五套、南岸陳家浦頂沖入溜，議培築舊堤。

translations.literal: At Wutao on the north bank and Chenjiapu on the south bank the main current bore in; it was proposed to strengthen and build up the old levees.
translations.idiomatic: At Wutao on the north bank and Chenjiapu on the south, the main current drove straight in, and officials proposed reinforcing the old levees.

sentences.zh: 臣以雲梯關外近海，與其築堤束水，不若於舊堤上首作斜長子堰，使水匯正河入海。

translations.literal: Your subject holds that outside Yunti Pass, near the sea, rather than building levees to constrain the water, it would be better to build an angled subsidiary weir at the head of the old levee, so that water gathers in the main channel and enters the sea.
translations.idiomatic: He argued that near the coast beyond Yunti Pass, rather than penning the water with new levees, an angled subsidiary weir at the head of the old dyke would concentrate flow in the main channel to the sea.

sentences.zh: 」上均是之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved all equally.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor endorsed the whole proposal.

sentences.zh: 三十年，遷兩江總督，仍統理南河事務。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, he was transferred to Governor-General of the Two Jiangs, still overseeing Southern River affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 he became Governor-General of the Two Jiangs while continuing to direct Southern River works.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，按蘇州同知段成功縱僕擾民，高晉以成功方病，擬寬之，上責其袒庇。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Duan Chenggong, sub-prefect of Suzhou, let his servants run wild and harass the people; Gao Jin, because Chenggong was ill, planned to treat him leniently, and the Emperor rebuked him for favoritism.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 Suzhou sub-prefect Duan Chenggong's servants harassed the people with his tacit consent. Gao Jin wanted leniency because Chenggong was ill; the Emperor condemned this as shielding a subordinate.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，署湖廣總督，兼攝荊州將軍事。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, he served as acting Governor-General of Huguang, concurrently taking charge of affairs as General of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 33 he acted as Governor-General of Huguang and also handled the duties of the Jingzhou garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，回任，兼署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, he returned to his post, concurrently serving as acting Governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 34 he resumed his original post and also served as acting Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 上命採洋銅鑄錢，高晉請收小錢，並運雲南銅供鑄，費省於洋銅，上用其議。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered foreign copper collected for coinage; Gao Jin requested that small coin also be collected, and that Yunnan copper be transported for minting, costing less than foreign copper; the Emperor adopted his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor ordered foreign copper for coinage, Gao Jin proposed accepting small coins and shipping Yunnan copper to the mints—a plan cheaper than relying on foreign metal, and the throne accepted it.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，兼署漕運總督，授文華殿大學士，兼禮部尚書，仍任總督如故。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, he concurrently served as acting Governor-General of Grain Transport, was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and concurrently Minister of Rites, and still held his governorship as before.
translations.idiomatic: In year 36 he also acted as grain transport governor-general, was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and Minister of Rites, and kept his governorship unchanged.

sentences.zh: 尋命同侍郎裘曰修、總督楊廷璋籌勘永定河工。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered, together with Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu and Governor-General Yang Tingzhang, to survey and plan Yongding River works.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent with Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu and Governor-General Yang Tingzhang to inspect Yongding River works.

sentences.zh: 事竟，還江南。

translations.literal: When the task was finished, he returned to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was done, he returned south.

sentences.zh: 四十年，河東河道總督姚立德奏請以蜀山湖收蓄伏秋汛水，工部以舊例蜀山湖於十月後收蓄汶河清水議駁，上命高晉會勘。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, Yao Lide, Director-General of Eastern River Conservancy, memorialized requesting that Shushan Lake store summer-autumn floodwater; the Board of Works rejected the proposal on the grounds that by old regulation Shushan Lake after the tenth month stored clear water from the Wen River; the Emperor ordered Gao Jin to join in survey.
translations.idiomatic: In year 40 Eastern River director Yao Lide asked to use Shushan Lake for summer-autumn flood storage. The Board of Works objected that by old rule the lake held Wen River clear water only after the tenth month. The Emperor sent Gao Jin to investigate jointly.

sentences.zh: 尋奏：「蜀山湖周六十五里，在汶河南、運河東，為第一水櫃。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized: "Shushan Lake has a circumference of sixty-five li, south of the Wen River and east of the Grand Canal; it is the primary water reservoir.
translations.idiomatic: He soon reported: "Shushan Lake, sixty-five li around, lies south of the Wen and east of the canal—the chief flood basin.

sentences.zh: 向定蓄水限九尺七八寸，請改以一丈一尺為率，兼蓄伏秋汛水。

translations.literal: The fixed storage limit had been nine chi seven or eight cun; he requested changing the standard to one zhang one chi, storing summer-autumn floodwater as well.
translations.idiomatic: The storage limit had been set at nine chi seven or eight cun; he asked to raise it to eleven chi and hold summer-autumn floodwater too.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: "] The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，河督吳嗣爵奏黃河淤高，命高晉與總督薩載籌議。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, River Director Wu Sijue memorialized that the Yellow River had silted up and risen; Gao Jin was ordered to consult with Governor-General Sa Zai.
translations.idiomatic: In year 41 River Director Wu Sijue reported that the Yellow River bed had risen with silt. Gao Jin was told to confer with Governor-General Sa Zai.

sentences.zh: 請浚清口以內引河停淤，使清水暢出，與黃河匯流東注，並力剔沙，則黃河不濬自深，海口不疏自治。

translations.literal: He requested dredging silted diversion channels within Qingkou so clear water flows freely, merges with the Yellow River and flows east; combined force scouring sand would then deepen the Yellow River without dredging and clear the river mouth without dredging.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed dredging silted channels inside Qingkou so clear water could run freely and join the Yellow River eastward—combined scour would deepen the river and clear the mouth without separate dredging campaigns.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「此奏甚合機宜形勢，為治淮、黃一大關鍵。

translations.literal: " The Emperor instructed: "This memorial fits the moment and conditions very well; it is a key link in governing the Huai and Yellow rivers.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "This fits the times and terrain—it is the key to managing the Huai and Yellow rivers.

sentences.zh: 屆時妥為之。

translations.literal: When the time comes, carry it out properly.
translations.idiomatic: See that it is done well when the time comes.

sentences.zh: 」是冬，入覲，上以高晉年七十，書榜以賜。

translations.literal: " That winter, he came to audience; the Emperor, because Gao Jin was seventy, bestowed an inscribed plaque.
translations.idiomatic: " That winter he came to court. Learning that Gao Jin had turned seventy, the Emperor gave him an inscribed plaque.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，命赴浙江會巡撫王亶望相度海塘，又命赴河南堵築儀封漫口。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, he was ordered to go to Zhejiang to survey the seawall together with Governor Wang Tanwang, and also ordered to go to Henan to block and build up the breach at Yifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In year 43 he was sent to Zhejiang with Governor Wang Tanwang to survey seawalls, and to Henan to close the Yifeng breach.

sentences.zh: 秋，河決時和驛，高晉請議處，命寬之。

translations.literal: In autumn the river breached at Shihe Post; Gao Jin requested disciplinary action; he was ordered to be lenient.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river broke at Shihe Post. Gao Jin asked to be punished; the Emperor declined to be harsh.

sentences.zh: 冬，時和驛工竟。

translations.literal: In winter the Shihe Post works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: By winter the Shihe Post repair was finished.

sentences.zh: 儀封新修埽工蟄陷，部議奪官，仍命留任。

translations.literal: Newly repaired revetment works at Yifeng subsided; the ministry proposed stripping him of rank, but he was still ordered to remain in office.
translations.idiomatic: Fresh revetments at Yifeng collapsed. The ministry recommended dismissal, but he was kept in post.

sentences.zh: 十二月，卒，賜祭葬，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he died; funeral rites were granted, and his posthumous title was Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth month. The court granted funeral honors and gave him the posthumous name Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 懷舊詩並列五督臣中。

translations.literal: He was listed among five governors in the nostalgic poem.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial nostalgic poem grouped him among five great governors.

sentences.zh: 子書麟、廣興，自有傳。

translations.literal: His sons Shulin and Guangxing have their own biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Shulin and Guangxing are treated in separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 完顏偉，完顏即其氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Wanyan Wei—Wanyan was his surname; he was a man of the Bordered Yellow Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Wei belonged to the Wanyan clan and came from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，自內務府筆帖式累遷戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng reign, from a clerk of the Imperial Household Department he was repeatedly promoted to vice director of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng he rose from an Imperial Household clerk to vice director in the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 命往江南學習河務。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go to Jiangnan to study river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to Jiangnan to learn river management.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，授浙江海防道。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, he was appointed coastal defense intendant of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 he became Zhejiang's coastal defense intendant.

sentences.zh: 調江南河務道，尋擢浙江按察使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Jiangnan river affairs intendant, and soon promoted to judicial commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Jiangnan's river conservancy post and was soon promoted to Zhejiang judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 方建尖山壩工，巡撫盧焯奏以偉督工，歲賚銀五百。

translations.literal: While the Jianshan Dam was being built, Governor Lu Chao memorialized that Wei should supervise the work, with five hundred taels granted annually.
translations.idiomatic: During construction of Jianshan Dam, Governor Lu Chao had Wei oversee the work and granted him five hundred taels a year.

sentences.zh: 六年，命為江南副總河，就擢河道總督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was appointed vice director-general of Jiangnan rivers, and was immediately promoted to director-general of river conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he became Jiangnan's deputy river director and was immediately promoted to river director-general.

sentences.zh: 高郵南關、五里、車邏三壩，值河、湖盛漲，洩水輒浸下河州縣民田。

translations.literal: The three dams at Nanguan, Wuli, and Cheluo in Gaoyou—when the river and lakes rose high, discharging water immediately inundated civilian fields in lower-river prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: At Gaoyou's Nanguan, Wuli, and Cheluo dams, high river and lake levels meant any discharge flooded lower-river farmland.

sentences.zh: 上命閉洪澤湖天然壩及三壩，不使水入下河。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the natural dam of Hongze Lake and the three dams closed, not letting water enter the lower river.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Hongze Lake's natural dam and the three sluice dams sealed so water would not spill into the lower river.

sentences.zh: 知州沈光曾以上河濱湖灘地被水，議以濟運餘水由三壩減洩，並易芒稻河閘為壩，疏寶應、高郵、甘泉諸湖南注之路。

translations.literal: Prefect Shen Guangceng, because lakeside tidal flats in the upper river were flooded, proposed using surplus transport water for controlled discharge through the three dams, and replacing the Mangdao River sluice with a dam, dredging southward routes from Baoying, Gaoyou, Ganquan, and other lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Shen Guangceng, citing flooded lakeside flats upstream, proposed controlled release of surplus transport water through the three dams, converting the Mangdao sluice to a dam, and opening southern outflow routes from Baoying, Gaoyou, and Ganquan lakes.

sentences.zh: 偉劾其擾亂河工，光曾坐奪官。

translations.literal: Wei impeached him for disrupting river works; Guangceng was stripped of his post.
translations.idiomatic: Wei impeached him for meddling with river works, and Shen lost his post.

sentences.zh: 初，上以黃河大溜逼清口，命循康熙舊跡，開陶莊引河，導使北注。

translations.literal: Initially, because the Yellow River's main current pressed on Qingkou, the Emperor ordered following Kangxi's old route to open the Taozhuang diversion channel, guiding it to flow north.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, with the Yellow River's main current pressing on Qingkou, the Emperor had ordered a Taozhuang diversion opened along Kangxi's old line to turn the flow north.

sentences.zh: 大學士鄂爾泰與河道總督高斌合勘，甫定議，會暴汛積淤，工遂停。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Ortai and River Director-General Gao Bin jointly surveyed; they had just settled on a plan when sudden flood silt accumulated and the work was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Ortai and River Director Gao Bin had just agreed on a plan when a flash flood deposited silt and the project stopped.

sentences.zh: 高斌亦去任，復命偉相度。

translations.literal: Gao Bin also left his post; Wei was again ordered to survey and plan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin then left office, and Wei was again told to reassess the site.

sentences.zh: 偉議自清口迤西黃河南岸設木龍挑溜，使漸趨而北。

translations.literal: Wei proposed setting wooden training structures west of Qingkou along the south bank of the Yellow River to deflect the current, gradually turning it northward.
translations.idiomatic: Wei proposed wooden training dikes west of Qingkou on the Yellow River's south bank to nudge the current gradually north.

sentences.zh: 七年，疏言：「淮源上游雨多水發，賈魯河盛漲，由渦達淮，匯於洪澤湖。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he memorialized: "Heavy rain in the upper Huai source raised the waters; the Jialu River swelled greatly, reaching the Huai through Wo and converging in Hongze Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he reported: "Heavy rains upstream flooded the Huai headwaters. The Jialu River rose sharply, reached the Huai through Wo County, and poured into Hongze Lake.

sentences.zh: 三石滾壩減歸高、寶、邵伯等湖，而古溝、東壩漫刷過水又自白馬湖來會，水勢益大。

translations.literal: The Three-Stone Rolling Dam discharged back to Gaoyou, Baoying, Shaobo, and other lakes; meanwhile overflow erosion at Gugou and Dongba brought water from Baima Lake to join, and the water force grew still greater.
translations.idiomatic: The Three-Stone Rolling Dam sent water back toward Gaoyou, Baoying, and Shaobo lakes, while overflow at Gugou and Dongba joined flows from Baima Lake, swelling the flood still further.

sentences.zh: 臣督築子堰捍禦，並開高郵老土壩及南關等三壩，水勢始定。

translations.literal: Your subject supervised building subsidiary weirs for defense, and also opened Gaoyou's old earthen dam and the three dams at Nanguan and elsewhere; only then did the water force stabilize.
translations.idiomatic: He oversaw subsidiary weirs for defense and opened Gaoyou's old earthen dam and the three Nanguan dams; only then did the waters settle.

sentences.zh: 」上嘉之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 是歲黃河亦盛漲，石林口減水過多，沛縣及山東魚台、滕、嶧諸縣皆被水。

translations.literal: That year the Yellow River also rose high; too much water was discharged at Shilinkou; Pei County and Yutai, Teng, and Yi counties in Shandong were all flooded.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yellow River also surged. Excessive discharge at Shilinkou flooded Pei County and Yutai, Teng, and Yi in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 偉具疏請罪。

translations.literal: Wei submitted a detailed memorial requesting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Wei submitted a full memorial accepting blame.

sentences.zh: 御史吳煒劾偉用人不得當，偉疏辨，上不深責，調河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Censor Wu Wei impeached Wei for improper appointments; Wei memorialized in defense; the Emperor did not heavily blame him, and transferred him to Director-General of Eastern River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wu Wei charged him with poor personnel choices. Wei rebutted the charge; the Emperor did not press the matter and moved him to Eastern River director-general.

sentences.zh: 九年，奏言：「山東歷年被水，由於上游散漫，下游梗阻。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he memorialized: "Shandong has been flooded year after year because upstream the water spreads out too widely and downstream it is blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he reported: "Shandong floods yearly because upstream waters spread unchecked while downstream channels choke.

sentences.zh: 運河東接汶、泗、沂、濟諸水，洩入微山、蜀山、南旺、馬踏諸湖；

translations.literal: The Grand Canal east connects the Wen, Si, Yi, and Ji rivers, discharging into Weishan, Shushan, Nanwang, and Mata lakes;
translations.idiomatic: Eastward the canal takes the Wen, Si, Yi, and Ji rivers into Weishan, Shushan, Nanwang, and Mata lakes;

sentences.zh: 北接漳、衛二水，洩入鹽河、徒駭、馬頰、鉤盤諸河。

translations.literal: North it connects the Zhang and Wei rivers, discharging into the Salt River, Tuhai, Majia, and Gouspan rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Northward it connects the Zhang and Wei rivers to the Salt River, Tuhai, Majia, and Gouspan channels.

sentences.zh: 遇伏秋異漲，宣洩不及，應於運河內增閘壩以分其勢，疏下河以暢其流。

translations.literal: When summer-autumn floods rise unusually high, discharge cannot keep pace; sluices and dams should be added within the canal to divide the force, and the lower river dredged to smooth the flow.
translations.idiomatic: In peak summer-autumn floods, outlets could not keep pace—he proposed more sluices and dams on the canal to split the force and dredging lower reaches to speed drainage.

sentences.zh: 其經由各州縣，凡溝渠淤狹者濬之，堤堰殘缺者修之。

translations.literal: Along the routes through various prefectures and counties, wherever ditches and channels were silted and narrow they should be dredged; wherever levees and dams were broken and incomplete they should be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Along every affected county he wanted silted channels dredged and broken levees repaired.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
