translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，以母老乞回京，有旨慰留。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because his mother was old he requested to return to the capital; an edict urged him to stay.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he asked to return to Beijing because his mother was aged; an edict urged him to remain.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he was made Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon after he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 顧琮，字用方，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，尚書顧八代孫。

translations.literal: Gu Cong, style name Yongfang, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a man of the Bordered Yellow Banner of the Manchus, a grandson of Minister Gu Badai.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong, styled Yongfang, was an Irgen Gioro of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and a grandson of Minister Gu Badai.

sentences.zh: 父顧儼，歷官副都統。

translations.literal: His father Gu Yan served as vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gu Yan had risen to vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 顧琮，以監生錄入算學館，修算法諸書，書成議敘。

translations.literal: Gu Cong, admitted to the School of Mathematics through a purchased degree, compiled books on mathematical methods; when the books were finished promotion was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Admitted to the School of Mathematics as a purchased-degree student, he helped compile mathematical treatises and was considered for promotion when the project was complete.

sentences.zh: 康熙六十一年，授吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year of Kangxi, he was appointed vice director of the Board of Civil Office.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 61 he became a vice director in the Board of Civil Office.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，授戶部郎中，遷御史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng, he was appointed bureau director of the Board of Revenue, then transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 he became a bureau director in Revenue, then a censor.

sentences.zh: 四年，巡視長蘆鹽政。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he inspected the Changlu salt administration.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he inspected the Changlu salt administration.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred to Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he became Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 九年，授霸州營田使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was appointed agricultural colonization commissioner of Baozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he was named Baozhou agricultural colonization commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一年，協理直隸總河，遷太常寺卿，署直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he assisted in directing Zhili river works, was transferred to Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and served as acting Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he assisted Zhili's chief river officer, became Minister of Imperial Sacrifices, and acted as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 尋授直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Director-General of Zhili River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Zhili river director-general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，奏報：「永定河口深通，上流始得暢注入淀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he reported: "The mouth of the Yongding River is deep and clear; upstream water can now flow freely into the marshes.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he reported: "The Yongding mouth runs deep and clear, so upstream water can pour freely into the lakes.

sentences.zh: 近因淤，議濬引河，自然開刷，不勞民力，號為天賜引河。

translations.literal: Recently because of silt, a diversion channel was proposed for dredging; it opened and scoured naturally, without taxing the people's labor; it is called the Heaven-bestowed Diversion Channel.
translations.idiomatic: Recent silt had choked the mouth, but a planned diversion scoured itself open without forced labor—they called it the Heaven-sent channel.

sentences.zh: 」上令報祀。

translations.literal: " The Emperor ordered a report for sacrificial rites.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor ordered rites of thanksgiving reported.

sentences.zh: 疏請更定管河廳汛，增設員缺，下部議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting revision of river management offices and flood posts, adding official posts; the ministry deliberated and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to reorganize river offices and flood posts and add staff; the ministry approved and carried it out.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, he served as acting Governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he acted as Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂回旗。

translations.literal: Upon mourning his father's death he returned to his banner.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to his banner to mourn his father.

sentences.zh: 二年，命協辦吏部尚書事。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was ordered to assist in managing affairs as Minister of the Board of Civil Office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he was told to assist the Minister of Civil Office.

sentences.zh: 永定河決，命偕總督李衛督修。

translations.literal: The Yongding River breached; he was ordered together with Governor-General Li Wei to supervise repairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongding breached, he was sent with Governor-General Li Wei to oversee repairs.

sentences.zh: 旋署河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon he served as acting Director-General of River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: He soon acted as river director-general.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，改授硃藻，命協同辦理。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, Zhu Zao was appointed in his stead, and he was ordered to assist jointly in management.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 3 Zhu Zao took the post and Gu was told to assist him.

sentences.zh: 奏畿輔西南諸水匯於東西兩淀，淤墊漫溢為患。

translations.literal: He memorialized that southwestern waters of the capital region converge in the eastern and western marshes, silted and overflowing—a source of trouble.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that southwestern capital-region waters pooling in the eastern and western marshes caused chronic silt and overflow.

sentences.zh: 請設垡船撈泥，以三角淀通判、清河同知司其事。

translations.literal: He requested establishing dredging boats to scoop mud, with the sub-prefect of Sanjiao Marsh and the sub-prefect of Qinghe overseeing the task.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed dredging boats under the Sanjiao Marsh and Qinghe sub-prefects to scoop silt.

sentences.zh: 藻罷去，复授河道總督。

translations.literal: When Zao was dismissed, he was again appointed Director-General of River Conservancy.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhu Zao was removed, Gu was again made river director-general.

sentences.zh: 五年，濬青縣興濟、滄州捷地兩減河，疏陳善後諸事，請疏海口，築遙堤，多設涵洞。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he dredged the two flood channels at Xingji in Qing County and Jiedi in Cangzhou, memorialized on follow-up matters, and requested dredging the river mouth, building distant levees, and setting up many culverts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he dredged relief channels at Xingji in Qing County and Jiedi in Cangzhou, outlined follow-up measures, and asked to open the estuary, build distant levees, and add culverts.

sentences.zh: 六年，請改定子牙河管河官制。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he requested revising the official system for managing the Ziya River.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he asked to reorganize Ziya River administration.

sentences.zh: 尋以裁缺回京。

translations.literal: Soon, because his post was abolished, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When his post was abolished he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 是年，授漕運總督。

translations.literal: That same year, he was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport.
translations.idiomatic: That year he became grain transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七年，奏言：「清江以上，運河兩岸，向來只知束水濟運，未知藉水灌田，坐聽萬頃源泉，未收涓滴之利。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he memorialized: "Above Qingjiang, along both banks of the canal, people have only known constraining water to aid transport, not using water to irrigate fields, sitting idle while tens of thousands of mu of spring water yielded not a drop of benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he argued that above Qingjiang the canal banks had served transport alone—no one had tapped the water for irrigation while vast springs went unused.

sentences.zh: 同此田畝，淮南、淮北，腴瘠相懸。

translations.literal: For the same fields, south and north of the Huai, fertility differs greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Fields on the same scale were lush south of the Huai and poor north of it.

sentences.zh: 或疑運河洩水，於濟運有妨。

translations.literal: Some suspect that discharging canal water would hinder grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Some feared that releasing canal water would harm transport.

sentences.zh: 不知漕艘道經淮、徐，五月上旬即可過竣。

translations.literal: They do not know that grain barges passing Huai and Xu can finish transit by the first ten days of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Yet grain fleets passed Huai and Xu by early fifth month.

sentences.zh: 稻田須水，正在夏秋間。

translations.literal: Paddy fields need water precisely during summer and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Rice fields needed water in summer and autumn—the very season when transport was done.

sentences.zh: 若屆時始行宣導，是祗借閉蓄之水為灌溉之資，於漕運初無所妨。

translations.literal: If discharge is only begun when the time comes, this merely uses stored water as irrigation resources, initially without harm to grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Timed release would use stored water for irrigation without touching transport flows.

sentences.zh: 況清江左右所建涵洞，成效彰彰。

translations.literal: Moreover, the culverts built left and right of Qingjiang have shown clear results.
translations.idiomatic: And the culverts already built around Qingjiang had proved their worth.

sentences.zh: 推此仿行，萬無疑慮。

translations.literal: Extending this and modeling on it, there is absolutely no cause for doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Applied elsewhere in the same way, he argued, there was no reason to hesitate.

sentences.zh: 請特遣大臣總理相度，會同督、撫、河臣詳酌興工。

translations.literal: I request that a minister be specially dispatched to take overall charge of surveying, and together with the governor-general, governor, and river commissioner carefully deliberate on beginning construction.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that a senior minister oversee the survey and, with the governor-general, provincial governor, and river commissioner, work out how to begin the work.

sentences.zh: 」議未及行。

translations.literal: " The proposal had not yet been implemented.
translations.idiomatic: " The plan was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 八年，以督運詣京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, in his capacity as grain transport supervisor he went to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he came to Beijing as grain transport supervisor.

sentences.zh: 入對，請行限田，上斥其擾民。

translations.literal: At audience he requested implementing land limits; the emperor rebuked him for troubling the people.
translations.idiomatic: At audience he proposed land-limit reforms; the emperor rebuked him for harassing the populace.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，疏請於馬莊集、曹家店各建石閘，束上游之水，並將駱馬湖入運處改在皁河以上車頭，建閘挑渠，引水濟運。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year, he memorialized requesting stone sluices be built at Mazhuangji and Caojiadian to constrain upstream water, and also that the point where Luoma Lake enters the transport canal be moved upstream to Chetou above Zao River, building sluices and excavating channels to draw water for transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 10 he proposed stone sluices at Mazhuangji and Caojiadian to hold back upstream water, and relocating the Luoma Lake intake above Zao River at Chetou, with new sluices and channels to feed the canal.

sentences.zh: 十字河竹絡壩開放後，黃水湍激，橫截運河，糧艘提溜為難。

translations.literal: After the Zhuhua Dam at Shizi River was opened, yellow water rushed turbulently and cut across the transport canal, making it difficult for grain barges to be towed upstream.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Zhuhua bamboo dam at Shizi River was opened, the Yellow River current surged across the canal and made upstream towing nearly impossible for grain barges.

sentences.zh: 當於竹谿壩下束黃壩迤東接堤堵截，別於蘇家閘南濬河越黃入運，從之。

translations.literal: It was proposed that below Zhuxi Dam the yellow dam be constrained, extending east to connect levees and block off the flow; separately, south of Sujia Sluice a channel should be dredged to cross the yellow water into the transport canal. This was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed to block the flow below Zhuxi Dam with levees extending east from the yellow dam, and to dredge a channel south of Sujia Sluice to carry Yellow River water across into the canal.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he served as acting Governor-General of Jiangnan River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he acted as Jiangnan river works governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，命偕大學士高斌按浙江巡撫常安貪婪狀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was ordered together with Grand Secretary Gao Bin to investigate the corruption of Zhejiang Governor Chang An.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he was sent with Grand Secretary Gao Bin to investigate corruption charges against Zhejiang Governor Chang An.

sentences.zh: 坐未窮治，奪官，命留任。

translations.literal: He was punished for failing to prosecute thoroughly; his office was stripped, but he was ordered to remain in his post.
translations.idiomatic: Found lax in the investigation, he was stripped of rank but told to keep his post.

sentences.zh: 尋調河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to Governor-General of Hedong River Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Hedong river works governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十七年，疏言：「運河堤未設堡房。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he memorialized: "Forts and posts had not been set up along the canal levees.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 he noted that the canal levees still lacked guard posts.

sentences.zh: 請視黃河例，每二里建堡房，都計四百餘座。

translations.literal: I request that following the Yellow River precedent, a fort be built every two li, totaling more than four hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Following Yellow River practice, he proposed guard posts every two li—more than four hundred in all.

sentences.zh: 」十九年，坐江南總河任內浮費工銀，奪官。

translations.literal: " In the nineteenth year, for wasteful spending of public works funds during his tenure as Jiangnan river commissioner, his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 19 he was dismissed for reckless spending on public works during his Jiangnan river commissionership.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon after he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 顧琮內行嚴正，嘗入對，值旱多風，世宗以為憂。

translations.literal: Gu Cong was strict and upright in private conduct. Once at audience, there was drought with much wind; the Yongzheng Emperor was troubled by it.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong was known for private rectitude. At one audience during drought and strong winds, the Yongzheng Emperor voiced his anxiety.

sentences.zh: 顧琮引洪範謂「蒙恆風若，慮臣或蔽君」，上為之動容。

translations.literal: Gu Cong cited the Hong Fan, saying "If wind persists, be wary lest ministers block the ruler," and the emperor was moved.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong quoted the Hong Fan—"When wind persists, fear that ministers may obscure the ruler"—and the emperor was visibly stirred.

sentences.zh: 世宗崩，顧琮方喪偶，逾三年乃續娶。

translations.literal: When the Yongzheng Emperor died, Gu Cong had just lost his wife; only after more than three years did he remarry.
translations.idiomatic: After Yongzheng's death Gu Cong was mourning his wife; he did not remarry until more than three years had passed.

sentences.zh: 方苞以為合禮。

translations.literal: Fang Bao considered this in accord with ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Bao judged this proper by ritual standards.

sentences.zh: 白鍾山，字毓秀，漢軍正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Bai Zhongshan, style name Yuxiu, was a man of the Plain Blue Banner of the Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Zhongshan, styled Yuxiu, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，自戶部筆帖式遷江南山清里河同知。

translations.literal: In the early Yongzheng period, from a clerk in the Board of Revenue he was transferred to assistant prefect of the Shanqingli River in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongzheng he rose from a Revenue clerk to assistant prefect in charge of the Shanqingli River in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 累擢江蘇布政使。

translations.literal: Through successive promotions he became Jiangsu Financial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to Jiangsu financial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 奏：「狼山、蘇松二鎮駐地距蘇州俱遠，軍糈輓運維艱，請就所駐及附近州縣配給。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The garrisons at Langshan and Susong are both far from Suzhou; transporting army rations by cart is difficult. I request rations be allocated at their stations and nearby prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He argued that the Langshan and Susong garrisons were too far from Suzhou for grain cartage and asked that rations be supplied locally.

sentences.zh: 崇明孤懸海外，地不產米，請由江、廣採運，撥萬石貯崇明倉，備平糶。

translations.literal: Chongming stands isolated beyond the sea and produces no rice; I request grain be procured and shipped from Jiangxi and Guangdong, with ten thousand shi stored in the Chongming granary for fair-price sale.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming, isolated offshore, grew no rice; he asked for grain shipped from Jiangxi and Guangdong, ten thousand shi held in reserve for famine relief sale.

sentences.zh: 海濱漲出沙洲，民人佔居，當築土墩以避潮患。

translations.literal: Sandbars emerge along the coast where people occupy them; earthen mounds should be built to ward off tidal disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Where coastal sandbars had been settled, he wanted earthen mounds built against tidal flooding.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年，授南河副總河，旋擢河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was appointed Deputy Commissioner of the Southern River; soon after he was promoted to Governor-General of Hedong River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he became deputy southern river commissioner, then Hedong river works governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，奏：「河標兵駐濟寧，無倉儲，每稱貸貴糴。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, he memorialized: "River troops garrisoned at Jining had no warehouses and often had to borrow money to buy grain at high prices.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he reported that river troops at Jining had no granaries and had to buy grain on credit at steep prices.

sentences.zh: 請以生息銀二千七百有奇買穀四千石，設倉存貯，春借秋收。

translations.literal: I request that interest-bearing silver of more than twenty-seven hundred taels be used to buy four thousand shi of grain, set up a warehouse for storage, lent in spring and repaid at autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed using accumulated interest—some 2,700 taels—to buy 4,000 shi of grain for a revolving spring-loan, autumn-repayment granary.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「豫東河防，水落時，當堵塞支河。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "For eastern Henan river defense, when water falls, branch streams should be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: " He also asked that eastern Henan branch streams be blocked when the water subsided.

sentences.zh: 伏秋水漲，購料募夫，每慮不及。

translations.literal: When summer-autumn floods rise, purchasing materials and hiring laborers is often feared to be too late.
translations.idiomatic: When summer floods came, there was never enough time to buy materials and hire labor.

sentences.zh: 請發河南、山東司庫銀分存鄭州及武陟、封丘、曹、單諸縣，永遠貯備。

translations.literal: I request treasury silver from Henan and Shandong be distributed and stored at Zhengzhou and the counties of Wuzhi, Fengqiu, Cao, and Shan for permanent reserve.
translations.idiomatic: He wanted Henan and Shandong treasury funds set aside permanently at Zhengzhou and counties including Wuzhi, Fengqiu, Cao, and Shan.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " All were approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，疏言：「漳水舊自直隸入海，康熙四十五年，引漳入衛濟運，故道漸淤，全歸衛河，勢難容受。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he memorialized: "The Zhang River formerly entered the sea from Zhili. In the forty-fifth year of Kangxi it was diverted into the Wei to aid transport; the old channel gradually silted, and all water went into the Wei River, which could hardly contain it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he explained that the Zhang River once reached the sea through Zhili; since Kangxi 45 it had been sent into the Wei for transport, silting its old bed until the Wei could barely hold the flow.

sentences.zh: 嗣於德州哨馬營建滾水壩，開引河洩衛水，由鉤盤河達老黃河入海。

translations.literal: Later an overflow dam was built at Shaomaying in Dezhou, a diversion channel opened to discharge Wei water, reaching the old Yellow River via the Gopan River to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: A spillway was later built at Dezhou's Shaomaying with a diversion channel sending excess Wei water through the Gopan River to the old Yellow River and the sea.

sentences.zh: 然漳、衛二水隨時淤塞，虛糜帑金。

translations.literal: Yet the Zhang and Wei waters silted up at intervals, wasting treasury funds.
translations.idiomatic: But both rivers kept silting and wasting public funds on constant dredging.

sentences.zh: 漳水舊有正河、支河，應擇易浚者復其故道。

translations.literal: The Zhang River originally had a main channel and branch channels; whichever is easier to dredge should be chosen to restore its old course.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed restoring whichever of the Zhang's main or branch channels could be dredged most easily.

sentences.zh: 於館陶建閘，衛水大，聽漳入海以防漲；

translations.literal: Build a sluice at Guantao; when Wei water is great, let the Zhang enter the sea to guard against flooding;
translations.idiomatic: A sluice at Guantao would, when the Wei ran high, release the Zhang to the sea against flooding;

sentences.zh: 衛水小，分漳入衛以濟運。

translations.literal: when Wei water is small, divide the Zhang into the Wei to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: when the Wei ran low, send part of the Zhang into it for transport.

sentences.zh: 」奏入，命大學士鄂爾泰詳議，議在丘縣東和爾寨村承漳河北折之勢，接開十餘裡，至漳洞村入舊河；

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, Grand Secretary Ortai was ordered to deliberate in detail. The plan was to follow the Zhang River's northward bend east of He'ercun in Qiu County, opening more than ten li to reach the old channel at Zhangdong Village;
translations.idiomatic: " Ortai was charged with review. The plan called for cutting more than ten li east of He'ercun in Qiu County along the Zhang's northward bend to rejoin the old channel at Zhangdong Village;

sentences.zh: 因於新河東流入衛處建閘，以時啟閉，上從之。

translations.literal: therefore a sluice would be built where the new channel flowed east into the Wei, opened and closed according to the season; the emperor adopted this.
translations.idiomatic: a sluice would regulate the new channel where it entered the Wei—the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 時漕運總督補熙請造十丈大船，運河當以水深四尺為則。

translations.literal: At the time, grain transport governor-general Bu Xi requested building hundred-foot ships; the canal should take four chi of water depth as standard.
translations.idiomatic: Grain transport chief Bu Xi then proposed hundred-foot barges and a uniform four-chi depth on the canal.

sentences.zh: 白鍾山謂：「徬河無源之水，雨至而後泉旺，泉旺而後河盈。

translations.literal: Bai Zhongshan said: "Branch rivers are water without source; only after rain do springs flourish, and only after springs flourish does the river fill.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Zhongshan objected that branch streams were fed only by rain—springs rose after rain, and only then did the rivers fill.

sentences.zh: 上徬閉、下徬啟，則下徬倍深，上徬倍淺。

translations.literal: If the upper branch is closed and the lower opened, the lower branch becomes twice as deep and the upper twice as shallow.
translations.idiomatic: Close the upper sluice and open the lower, and the lower reach doubles in depth while the upper grows shallower.

sentences.zh: 各徬相距遠近不均，水近者深，則遠者必淺。

translations.literal: The branches are at unequal distances; where water is near it runs deep, and where far it must be shallow.
translations.idiomatic: Sluices were unevenly spaced—nearby stretches ran deep while distant ones inevitably ran shallow.

sentences.zh: 以人役水，以水送舟，必不能均深四尺。

translations.literal: Using men to command water and water to carry boats, it is impossible for all to be uniformly four chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: Human effort cannot wring a uniform four-chi depth from such a system.

sentences.zh: 」侍郎趙殿最又請於館陶、臨清各立衛河水則，白鍾山謂：「尺寸不足，將衛輝民田渠徬盡閉，致妨灌溉，事既難行，尺寸既足，將官渠官徬盡閉，來源頓息。

translations.literal: " Vice Minister Zhao Dianzui also requested setting water gauges for the Wei at Guantao and Linqing. Bai Zhongshan said: "If the measure is insufficient, all sluices and channels for civilian fields at Weihui will be closed, hindering irrigation—this is hard to carry out; if the measure is sufficient, all official channels and sluices will be closed and the source will suddenly cease.
translations.idiomatic: " Vice Minister Zhao Dianzui wanted Wei water gauges at Guantao and Linqing. Bai Zhongshan countered that too low a gauge would shut every farmer's sluice at Weihui and ruin irrigation, while too high a gauge would shut official channels and choke the source.

sentences.zh: 下流已逝，運河之水亦立見消涸。

translations.literal: Once the lower stream has passed, the canal water will immediately be seen to dry up.
translations.idiomatic: Downstream flow would vanish and the canal would dry up at once.

sentences.zh: 二者均屬非計。

translations.literal: Both are impractical plans.
translations.idiomatic: Either way the scheme was unworkable.

sentences.zh: 」議並寢。

translations.literal: " Both proposals were shelved.
translations.idiomatic: " Both plans were dropped.

sentences.zh: 八年，調江南河道總督，疏言：「石林口堵築堅固，大溜直趨下流。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred to Governor-General of Jiangnan River Works and memorialized: "The blocking at Shilinkou is solid; the main current runs straight toward the lower reach.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, transferred to Jiangnan river works, he reported that the Shilinkou closure was holding and the main current drove straight downstream.

sentences.zh: 黃村、韓家塘等處新築子堰，恐不足抵禦，於對岸濬引河，導溜南注，並加厚子堰，派兵駐防。

translations.literal: At Huangcun, Hanjiatang, and other places newly built subsidiary dikes may not suffice to resist; on the opposite bank diversion channels should be dredged to guide the current southward, the subsidiary dikes thickened, and troops dispatched to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: New subsidiary dikes at Huangcun and Hanjiatang might not hold; he proposed opposite-bank diversion channels to steer the current south, thicker subsidiary dikes, and garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 」又奏言：「葦蕩左右兩營，歲輸柴二百二十五萬束。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "The left and right reed-marsh camps supply two million two hundred fifty thousand bundles of firewood annually.
translations.idiomatic: " He also noted that the two reed-marsh camps supplied 2.25 million bundles of firewood each year.

sentences.zh: 積久生弊，輪運不齊。

translations.literal: Over time abuses arose and deliveries fell uneven.
translations.idiomatic: Longstanding abuses had made deliveries erratic.

sentences.zh: 請禁兵民雜採，定採葦期限，濬運柴溝渠，編柴船幫號。

translations.literal: I request prohibiting soldiers and civilians from mixed harvesting, fixing deadlines for reed cutting, dredging the firewood transport channels, and organizing firewood boat convoys by number.
translations.idiomatic: He wanted mixed civilian-military harvesting banned, fixed cutting seasons, dredged firewood channels, and numbered boat convoys.

sentences.zh: 」皆允行。

translations.literal: " All were approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " All was approved.

sentences.zh: 十一年，御史楊開鼎劾：「白鍾山出納慳吝，任情駁減，用損工偷，縱僕役婪索。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Censor Yang Kaiding impeached: "Bai Zhongshan is miserly in receipts and disbursements, arbitrarily reduces estimates, uses funds to underpay work and steal, and indulges servants in extortion.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Censor Yang Kaiding charged Bai with stinting on accounts, arbitrary cuts to estimates, shoddy work, and extortion by his servants.

sentences.zh: 陳家浦決七百餘丈，止稱二十餘丈。

translations.literal: The breach at Chenjiapu was more than seven hundred zhang, yet he reported only twenty-odd zhang.
translations.idiomatic: A seven-hundred-zhang breach at Chenjiapu he had reported as twenty-odd zhang.

sentences.zh: 興築延緩，阜寧、鹽城二縣受其害。

translations.literal: Construction was delayed, and Funing and Yancheng counties suffered harm.
translations.idiomatic: Delayed repairs had harmed Funing and Yancheng.

sentences.zh: 」命高斌會尹繼善按治，以開鼎從。

translations.literal: " Gao Bin was ordered to investigate jointly with Yin Jishan, with Kaiding accompanying.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Bin and Yin Jishan were ordered to investigate, with Kaiding along.

sentences.zh: 尋覆奏駁減、婪索無實據，惟陳家浦漫口沖刷，貽害累民。

translations.literal: Soon they reported back: the charges of arbitrary reduction and extortion lacked evidence, but the Chenjiapu overflow break had scoured the banks and harmed the people.
translations.idiomatic: Their report cleared him of shortchanging and extortion but confirmed that the Chenjiapu breach had scour damage that hurt local people.

sentences.zh: 上召白鍾山詣京師，奪官，效力河工。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Bai Zhongshan to the capital, stripped his office, and ordered him to serve at river works.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Bai to Beijing, stripped his rank, and set him to river labor.

sentences.zh: 總河顧琮复論白鍾山措處失當，上命籍其貲逾十萬以償。

translations.literal: River commissioner Gu Cong again argued that Bai Zhongshan's handling had been improper; the emperor ordered his property of more than one hundred thousand seized for compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Cong added that Bai's handling had been wrong; the emperor ordered more than 100,000 taels of his property seized in restitution.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授永定河道。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was appointed commissioner of the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he was made Yongding River commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十八年，河決張家路，命從尚書舒赫德往勘。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the river breached at Zhangjialu; he was ordered to accompany Minister Suhede to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18, after a breach at Zhangjialu, he was sent with Minister Suhede to inspect.

sentences.zh: 旋命以按察使銜協辦南河事。

translations.literal: Soon after he was ordered to assist in southern river affairs with the rank of surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon given surveillance-commissioner rank to help manage southern river works.

sentences.zh: 十九年，复授河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, he was again appointed Governor-General of Hedong River Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he was again made Hedong river works governor-general.

sentences.zh: 二十年，署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, he served as acting Governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 he acted as Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 請罷孔氏世襲曲阜知縣，上命改授世襲六品官。

translations.literal: He requested abolishing the Kong family's hereditary post as Qufu magistrate; the emperor ordered them given a hereditary sixth-rank office instead.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to end the Kong family's hereditary Qufu magistracy; the emperor replaced it with a hereditary sixth-rank post.

sentences.zh: 尋奏濟寧以南積水未消，請緩開汶河大壩，疏濬下游河道。

translations.literal: Soon after he memorialized that standing water south of Jining had not subsided, requesting delay in opening the Wen River great dam and dredging downstream channels.
translations.idiomatic: He then reported standing water south of Jining and asked to delay opening the Wen River main dam while dredging downstream.

sentences.zh: 上命白鍾山往勘南河，文武各官聽調遣。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Bai Zhongshan to inspect the southern river; civil and military officials of all ranks were to obey his dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Bai to inspect the southern river with authority over all local officials.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，調江南河道總督，疏言：「自河決張家路，沙停河淤，下流不暢，南高北洼。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, he was transferred to Governor-General of Jiangnan River Works and memorialized: "Since the breach at Zhangjialu, sand has settled and the river silted; the lower reach is not smooth, higher in the south and lower in the north.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22, made Jiangnan river commissioner, he wrote that since Zhangjialu the river had silted, the lower reach blocked, high in the south and low in the north.

sentences.zh: 迨孫家集復決，河底益高。

translations.literal: When Sunjiaji breached again, the riverbed grew even higher.
translations.idiomatic: After Sunjiaji breached again the riverbed rose further.

sentences.zh: 黃河受病，率由水勢側注北岸，沖刷溝槽。

translations.literal: The Yellow River's affliction comes chiefly from the water's force pouring sideways onto the north bank and scouring gullies.
translations.idiomatic: The river's trouble came mainly from current shearing onto the north bank and gouging gullies.

sentences.zh: 惟有南北分籌，南宜疏，北宜築。

translations.literal: Only by planning separately for south and north will it suffice—the south should be dredged, the north should be built up.
translations.idiomatic: North and south needed different remedies: dredging in the south, building in the north.

sentences.zh: 築則支河不致奪溜，疏則稍分有餘之水勢，庶徐州得以少安。

translations.literal: Building prevents branch streams from stealing the current; dredging slightly divides surplus water force, so that Xuzhou may find some relief.
translations.idiomatic: Building would keep branch streams from stealing the main current; dredging would bleed off excess force—Xuzhou might breathe easier.

sentences.zh: 臣與河臣張師載商榷，以為南岸長灘較北岸更險，必於橫亙處濬引河，導溜歸中，岸堤益加高厚。

translations.literal: Your subject together with river commissioner Zhang Shizai discussed and considered the long beach on the south bank more dangerous than the north; diversion channels must be dredged at the transverse bar to guide the current back to center, and bank levees made higher and thicker.
translations.idiomatic: He and river commissioner Zhang Shizai agreed the south bank's long shoal was more dangerous than the north's; they wanted diversion cuts at the bar to center the current and higher, thicker levees.

sentences.zh: 北岸無堤，漫水如梁家馬路、徐家莊等處支河數十道，及黃家莊、郭家堂等處漫槽矮灘，宜築土壩。

translations.literal: On the north bank there are no levees; overflowing water spreads through dozens of branch streams at places like Liangjia Malu and Xujiazhuang, and shallow overflow troughs at Huangjiazhuang and Guojiatang—earthen dams should be built.
translations.idiomatic: The north bank had no levees; overflow at Liangjia Malu, Xujiazhuang, and elsewhere fed dozens of branch streams, with shallow troughs at Huangjiazhuang and Guojiatang—all needed earthen dams.

sentences.zh: 水平則收束以刷正河，水漲則平漫平消，不至衝槽奪溜。

translations.literal: When water is level, it is constrained to scour the main channel; when it rises, it spreads and is evenly dissipated, not rushing into gullies and stealing the current.
translations.idiomatic: At normal levels the dams would concentrate flow to scour the main channel; at flood they would spread and dissipate it rather than gouge new courses.

sentences.zh: 並於孫家集培堤增壩，以為重障。

translations.literal: Additionally at Sunjiaji levees should be raised and dams added as a second barrier.
translations.idiomatic: At Sunjiaji they would raise levees and add dams as a second line of defense.

sentences.zh: 駱馬湖北受蒙陰山水，西受微山湖水，其尾閭在六塘河。

translations.literal: Luoma Lake receives Mengyin mountain water from the north and Weishan Lake water from the west; its outlet is at Liutang River.
translations.idiomatic: Luoma Lake took Mengyin mountain runoff from the north and Weishan Lake water from the west, draining through Liutang River.

sentences.zh: 上游湖堤在在殘缺，亟應修補捍防。

translations.literal: Upstream lake levees are everywhere broken and incomplete; repair and defense are urgently needed.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream lake levees were broken in many places and needed urgent repair.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " All was approved.

sentences.zh: 荊山橋工竟，議敘。

translations.literal: When the Jingshan Bridge project was finished, promotion was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jingshan Bridge work was done, he was considered for promotion.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「寧夏上游河水陡漲，急報下游防範。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "When upstream water at Ningxia rises abruptly, urgent report should reach downstream for defense.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed urgent notice downstream when Ningxia's upper river surged.

sentences.zh: 正陽關為淮水上下關鍵，應仿寧夏水報法，派員專司其事。

translations.literal: Zhengyang Pass is the key to the Huai River's upper and lower reaches; following Ningxia's water-report method, officers should be assigned solely to this task.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyang Pass was the Huai's vital hinge; he wanted a Ningxia-style water-report system with dedicated officers.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「上江諸水皆歸安河以達洪澤湖。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized: "All waters of the upper river district converge through the An River to reach Hongze Lake.
translations.idiomatic: " He also noted that upper-river waters all drained to Hongze Lake through the An River.

sentences.zh: 安河間段淤淺，連年水患由此。

translations.literal: Sections of the An River are silted and shallow; year after year water disasters arise from this.
translations.idiomatic: Silted stretches of the An River had caused floods year after year.

sentences.zh: 宜多募漁船，伐蘆撈泥，俾尾閭一通，上游皆有去路。

translations.literal: Many fishing boats should be hired to cut reeds and scoop mud, so that once the outlet is open, upstream all have ways to drain.
translations.idiomatic: He wanted fishing boats hired to cut reeds and dredge mud so the outlet could open and upstream waters find an exit.

sentences.zh: 又歸仁堤下舊有涵洞，穿鮑家河以達安河，久經湮塞。

translations.literal: Under Guijen Levee there were formerly culverts passing through Baojia River to reach the An River, long since silted shut.
translations.idiomatic: Culverts under Guijen Levee once linked the Baojia River to the An River but had long been blocked.

sentences.zh: 擬開浚分林子河一支，則安河進水之地亦有所分，患可漸減。

translations.literal: It is proposed to open and dredge a branch of the Fenzilin River, so that points where the An River takes in water may also be divided, and the disaster can gradually lessen.
translations.idiomatic: Opening a branch of the Fenzilin River would split inflow to the An River and gradually ease the flooding.

sentences.zh: 」報聞。

translations.literal: " The report was noted.
translations.idiomatic: " The court took note.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, he was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒，贈太子太保，賜祭葬，諡莊恪。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he died; he was posthumously given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted sacrificial rites and burial honors, and given the posthumous name Zhuangke.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year 26 and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, with state funeral honors and the posthumous name Zhuangke ("Steadfast and Respectful").

sentences.zh: 論曰：自靳輔治河、淮，繼其後者，疏濬修築，守成法惟謹。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Since Jin Fu governed the Yellow and Huai rivers, those who followed him dredged, cleared, built, and repaired, guarding established methods with scrupulous care.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: After Jin Fu's governance of the Yellow and Huai, his successors dredged and built on, holding to established methods with scrupulous care.

sentences.zh: 世宗朝，齊蘇勒最著，嵇曾筠、高斌皆仍世繼業，與靳輔同祠河上，有功德於民，克應祭法。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng reign, Qi Sulei was most prominent; Ji Cengyun and Gao Bin both continued the family profession for generations, joining Jin Fu in river-side temples, having merit toward the people and fitting the standards for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng, Qi Sulei stood foremost; Ji Cengyun and Gao Bin carried on family river-work traditions and shared temples with Jin Fu—men whose public service merited state sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 完顏偉、顧琮、白鍾山隨事補苴，不負當官之責。

translations.literal: Wanyan Wei, Gu Cong, and Bai Zhongshan patched matters as events arose, not failing in their official responsibilities.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Wei, Gu Cong, and Bai Zhongshan improvised repairs as crises arose and did not neglect their duties.

sentences.zh: 高斌任事二十年，疏毛家鋪引河，排眾議行之，民蒙其利。

translations.literal: Gao Bin served twenty years; he dredged the Maojiapu diversion channel, overcame popular opposition to implement it, and the people received its benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Bin served twenty years, opened the Maojiapu diversion against opposition, and the people profited.

sentences.zh: 奪淮之役，縛赴工次待決。

translations.literal: In the campaign to seize the Huai, he was bound and sent to the worksite to await judgment.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huai-seizure affair he was bound and sent to the work camp to await sentence.

sentences.zh: 雷霆不測之威，赫矣哉！

translations.literal: The majesty of thunder, unpredictable in its might—how awe-inspiring!
translations.idiomatic: How awe-inspiring is the unpredictable majesty of thunder!
